paper.title: REFRAMED: Towards Realistic Audio Description Generation for Movies
paper.abstract: Audio Description (AD) is a verbal narration of key visual content in videos, enabling access for visually impaired audiences. Unlike standard video captioning, AD is a structured editorial task: descriptions must be inserted into gaps in dialogue and must convey only what is needed to understand the narrative being told. However, existing approaches formulate AD generation in an artificial setting where both the content and timing of descriptions are pre-specified, reducing the task to clip-lev

summary.core_problem: 现有电影音频描述（AD）生成任务被简化为片段级字幕，脱离真实场景中需同时决定描述内容与插入时机的结构化编辑需求。
summary.importance: 数据与任务范式贡献：重新定义电影AD生成为联合内容+时序决策任务，并发布高质量专业标注数据集REFRAMED，覆盖206部电影的美英双语AD。
summary.technical_approach: 提出新任务设定：模型需在对话间隙自主决定描述什么、何时插入；构建REFRAMED数据集，包含专业AD、字幕、对齐剧本与场景切分，替代此前依赖噪声转录与对齐管线的方案。
summary.experiments: 数据集规模2023个视频、3302个场景、206部电影，含美英两版专业AD与字幕；论文摘要未完整报告基线模型与量化结果。
summary.authors_note: Mirella Lapata、Frank Keller为爱丁堡大学NLP资深研究者，长期从事多模态语义与文本生成研究。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing audio description (AD) research reduces movie AD to clip-level captioning, ignoring the real editorial requirement of jointly deciding what to describe and when to insert narration into dialogue gaps.
summary_en.importance: Task reformulation and data contribution: redefines movie AD generation as a joint content+temporal decision problem and releases REFRAMED, a high-quality professionally annotated dataset with American and British AD across 206 movies.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduce a realistic AD formulation where models jointly select descriptive content and insertion timings; build REFRAMED with professional AD transcripts, subtitles, aligned scripts and scene splits, avoiding noisy transcription and alignment pipelines used in prior work.
summary_en.experiments: REFRAMED covers 2,023 videos, 3,302 scenes and 206 movies with dual-version professional AD and subtitles; full baseline metrics are not reported in the provided abstract.
summary_en.authors_note: Mirella Lapata and Frank Keller are senior NLP researchers at the University of Edinburgh, working on multimodal semantics and text generation.

recommendation.zh: 任务定义与数据集工作，面向视障辅助的垂直多模态生成，与通用多模态预训练方法论关联较弱，仅作领域背景备查。
recommendation.en: A task-reformulation and dataset paper for accessibility-focused multimodal generation; weakly connected to general multimodal pretraining methodology, keep as domain background only.

paper.title: ControlRef: Efficient Layout-Guided Multi-Instance Generation via Anchored 4D-RoPE
paper.abstract: Layout-guided multi-instance generation is essential for controllable image synthesis in Multi-Modal Diffusion Transformers (MM-DiTs). However, integrating this capability into unified architectures remains challenging. Prior frameworks rely on redundant full-resolution canvas padding and Shifted-RoPE to manage multiple reference images. This mechanism drastically inflates computational overhead for sparse layouts and disrupts critical low-frequency RoPE features, creating a severe spatial-frequ

summary.core_problem: 解决多模态扩散Transformer中布局引导多实例生成任务里，现有全分辨率填充+Shifted-RoPE方案计算开销大、破坏低频RoPE特征导致空间对应模糊的问题
summary.importance: 多模态生成方向的方法创新，提出新的注意力掩码机制与位置编码方案
summary.technical_approach: 提出ControlRef框架：1）用统一实例-布局控制注意力掩码严格解耦实例间语义交互，强制区域绑定；2）提出锚定式4D-RoPE直接将token锚定到对应空间位置，替代Shifted-RoPE
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露具体模型参数量、训练数据规模、基线模型及量化提升幅度，仅说明相较现有方案降低稀疏布局计算开销、提升空间对齐精度

summary_en.core_problem: Solve the high computational overhead and blurred spatial correspondence caused by existing full-resolution padding + Shifted-RoPE pipelines for layout-guided multi-instance generation in Multimodal Diffusion Transformers
summary_en.importance: Method innovation in multimodal generation, proposing a novel attention mask mechanism and positional encoding scheme
summary_en.technical_approach: Propose the ControlRef framework: 1) Use a Unified Instance-Layout Control attention mask to strictly decouple inter-instance semantic interactions and enforce regional binding; 2) Introduce Anchored 4D-RoPE that directly anchors tokens to corresponding spatial positions to replace Shifted-RoPE
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not disclose specific model parameters, training data scale, baselines or quantitative improvement margins; it only claims reduced compute overhead for sparse layouts and improved spatial alignment over prior schemes

recommendation.zh: 锚定式4D-RoPE的设计思路对多模态统一预训练的位置编码优化有微弱参考，仅扫方法部分的位置编码设计即可
recommendation.en: The Anchored 4D-RoPE design offers minor reference for positional encoding optimization in unified multimodal pretraining; only skim the positional encoding section in the method part

paper.title: Hunyuan3D-Buffalo 1.0: A Unified Multimodal Model for Scalable 3D Generation, Understanding, and Editing
paper.abstract: Recent advances in image generation have demonstrated the potential of unified multimodal models that integrate understanding, generation, and editing. However, unified 3D modeling remains constrained by scarce multimodal data, particularly the lack of large-scale and geometrically consistent editing data. To address this limitation, we propose Hunyuan3D-Buffalo 1.0, a unified framework supporting 3D understanding, text-to-3D generation, instruction-guided 3D editing, and text-grounded part gene

summary.core_problem: 当前3D生成领域的理解、生成、编辑三类能力长期以独立系统形式开发，核心瓶颈是缺乏大规模、几何一致的多任务3D训练语料，尤其是高质量编辑数据极度稀缺，既阻碍了统一3D多模态模型的规模化训练，也无法验证统一建模范式下跨任务是否存在能力协同效应。
summary.importance: 是工业界落地跨模态统一预训练的代表性工作，将AR+扩散联合建模范式从2D多模态拓展至3D领域，验证了理解、生成、编辑三类任务在单模型内统一训练的增益并非简单叠加，而是存在可测量的双向能力迁移，为后续统一多模态基座的任务设计、数据配比提供了经过生产验证的实践参考。
summary.technical_approach: 首先构建87M规模的3D多模态训练语料，包含25M理解样本、50M文生3D配对数据、12M经由Nano3D-v2智能体流程生成的几何一致编辑对。Nano3D-v2整合了锚视角选择、可学习的3D编辑区域定位、体素级编辑、几何与纹理精修、基于VLM的标注与过滤全链路，解决了编辑数据规模化生产的一致性问题。在此数据基础上，先训练面向3D细粒度语义、结构、空间理解的Hunyuan3D-VLM，支持物体描述、部件级问答、3D指代定位、编辑指令合成等能力，为后续生成和编辑任务提供语义与空间推理基础。最后将Hunyuan3D-VLM与初始化自Hunyuan3D-2.1的3D-DiT扩散生成骨干连接，通过统一条件接口将VLM的自回归推理输出作为扩散生成的引导信号，单架构同时支持3D理解、文生3D生成、指令引导3D编辑、文本指代部件生成四类能力，其中部件生成未设计专用管线，直接作为指令跟随类条件生成任务实现。
summary.experiments: 模型在文生3D、3D编辑公开基准上达到领先性能。消融实验明确观测到两类跨任务协同效应：一是更强的文生3D生成先验可以提升编辑结果的几何完整性与自然度，二是更强的3D理解能力可以提升编辑区域定位精度、指令解读准确度与未编辑区域的身份保持效果。统一训练下部件生成能力可直接涌现，无需针对该任务单独设计模型结构或训练流程。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注三部分内容：一是数据章节中Nano3D-v2编辑数据构造流程，这是突破3D统一建模数据瓶颈的核心，可对比此前3D编辑数据构造方法的设计取舍；二是架构章节中自回归VLM与DiT扩散骨干的连接方式，注意条件注入接口的设计，可与2D领域Transfusion、Chameleon、Show-o等AR+扩散联合建模方案做横向比较；三是实验部分的跨任务协同消融，重点关注不同任务混合比例下的性能变化曲线，以及理解、生成能力分别对编辑任务的增益拆分。预计精读时间60分钟。
summary.authors_note: 腾讯混元3D团队

summary_en.core_problem: 3D understanding, generation, and editing have long been developed as siloed, separate systems. The core bottleneck is the lack of large-scale, geometrically consistent multi-task 3D training corpus, particularly high-quality editing data, which prevents scalable training of unified 3D multimodal models and leaves untested whether cross-task capability synergy exists under a unified modeling paradigm.
summary_en.importance: This is a production-grade implementation of unified multimodal pretraining that extends the autoregressive + diffusion joint modeling paradigm from 2D vision to the 3D domain. It verifies that combining understanding, generation, and editing in a single model does not produce merely additive performance gains, but enables measurable bidirectional capability transfer across tasks. The work provides actionable, production-tested reference for task design and data mixture configuration for future unified multimodal foundation models.
summary_en.technical_approach: The team first builds an 87M-scale 3D multimodal corpus, consisting of 25M understanding samples, 50M text-to-3D pairs, and 12M geometrically consistent editing pairs generated via Nano3D-v2, an agent-based data pipeline that integrates anchor view selection, learned edit region localization, voxel-level editing, geometry and texture refinement, and VLM-powered annotation and filtering to produce consistent editing data at scale. On top of this dataset, they train Hunyuan3D-VLM, a vision-language model optimized for fine-grained 3D semantic, structural, and spatial understanding, supporting captioning, part-level QA, 3D grounding, and edit instruction synthesis to provide reasoning foundations for downstream generative tasks. Hunyuan3D-VLM is connected to a 3D-DiT generative backbone initialized from Hunyuan3D-2.1, with a unified conditional interface that passes AR reasoning outputs to guide diffusion-based 3D synthesis. The final single architecture supports four core capabilities: 3D understanding, text-to-3D generation, instruction-guided 3D editing, and text-grounded part generation, where part generation is implemented as a standard instruction-following conditional generation task without dedicated pipeline design.
summary_en.experiments: The model achieves leading performance on public text-to-3D generation and 3D editing benchmarks. Ablation studies identify two clear cross-task synergies: stronger text-to-3D generative priors improve edited geometry completeness and naturalness, while stronger 3D understanding improves edit region localization, instruction interpretation, and identity preservation of unedited regions. Part generation capability emerges directly from unified training without task-specific architecture or training design.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on three sections: First, the Nano3D-v2 editing data construction pipeline in the data curation chapter, which addresses the core bottleneck of unified 3D modeling; compare its design tradeoffs against prior 3D editing data construction methods. Second, the architecture chapter detailing the interface between the AR VLM and DiT diffusion backbone; compare the conditional injection design against joint AR+diffusion implementations for 2D, including Transfusion, Chameleon, and Show-o. Third, the cross-task synergy ablation in the experiments chapter, paying close attention to performance curves across different task mixture ratios, and the decomposed gain from understanding and generation capabilities on editing performance. Estimated reading time: 60 minutes.
summary_en.authors_note: Tencent Hunyuan 3D Team

recommendation.zh: 作为 3D 统一建模技术报告扫一遍数据构成即可；离文本基座较远，别把它当通用 LM recipe。
recommendation.en: Glance at the dataset composition as a 3D unified-modeling report; it is too far from text foundation pretraining to treat as a general LM recipe.

paper.title: How we built a realtime system for responsive voice AI in six months
paper.abstract: GPT-Live enables continuous voice interaction with AI, using a turnless speech model and low-latency architecture for faster, more natural conversations.

summary.core_problem: 说明 OpenAI 如何在六个月内构建低延迟、可连续语音交互的实时 voice AI 系统。
summary.importance: 贡献类型更接近语音多模态生成与实时系统工程经验，而不是完整论文；对预训练研究员的价值在于理解语音 LM 从离线生成走向 turnless、streaming、低延迟交互时，模型目标和 serving 约束如何耦合。
summary.technical_approach: 核心是 GPT-Live 的 turnless speech model 与低延迟系统架构：减少显式轮次边界依赖，让模型能在连续语音流中响应；同时通过端到端延迟预算、流式处理和系统管线优化提升交互自然度。
summary.experiments: 公开摘要未披露模型参数量、训练数据、语音 tokenizer、损失函数、对比基线或具体延迟数字；可确认的结果是系统层面实现了连续语音交互和更快响应，但缺少可复现实验表格。
summary.authors_note: OpenAI Research 发布的技术博客；OpenAI 在实时语音、多模态交互和大规模模型 serving 上有代表性系统工作。

summary_en.core_problem: The article explains how OpenAI built a low-latency realtime voice AI system for continuous speech interaction in six months.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is closer to speech-generation and realtime systems practice than to a full research paper. For pretraining researchers, the useful signal is how speech LMs move from offline generation to turnless, streaming, latency-constrained interaction.
summary_en.technical_approach: The system centers on GPT-Live, described as a turnless speech model paired with a low-latency architecture. It reduces reliance on explicit turn boundaries, supports continuous speech streams, and optimizes the serving pipeline around end-to-end latency.
summary_en.experiments: The public abstract does not disclose parameter counts, training data, tokenizer design, objectives, baselines, or concrete latency numbers. The reported outcome is a working continuous voice-interaction system with faster and more natural responses, but not a reproducible benchmark table.
summary_en.authors_note: Published by OpenAI Research; OpenAI has visible system-level work in realtime speech, multimodal interaction, and large-model serving.

recommendation.zh: 只看 turnless speech model 与延迟预算拆解；预训练细节不足，但能校准语音 LM 的系统约束。
recommendation.en: Read only for the turnless speech-model and latency-budget breakdown; pretraining details are thin, but it calibrates the system constraints for speech LMs.

paper.title: Let Me Look at You: Advanced Facial Expression Modeling for Conversational Speech Synthesis
paper.abstract: Conversational Speech Synthesis is a fundamental component of human-computer interaction, aiming to generate contextually appropriate, expressive, and empathetic speech. However, facial expressions encode subtle and rich affective cues that are crucial for empathetic speech interaction, whereas existing approaches often overlook this important modality. In addition, the lack of large-scale natural conversational datasets with both speech and visual modalities also limits the development of visua

summary.core_problem: 研究如何在对话式语音合成中利用面部表情信息，生成更符合上下文和情感状态的语音。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态生成方法与 tokenizer 设计。它不是通用语音 LM 预训练报告，但把 facial expression 离散成 token 并接入 LLM backbone，对统一多模态 tokenization 有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 FacialTalker，一个 facial-expression-aware conversational speech synthesis 框架。核心组件是 AUTokenizer：用单 codebook 把每帧面部表情离散为紧凑 token，并用 facial Action Unit 组合进行监督训练。还提出 DualDPO，用偏好优化进一步约束生成语音与表情/情感的一致性。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出训练数据规模、模型参数量、baseline 名称和具体提升幅度。论文声称针对现有自然对话数据中语音-视觉模态不足的问题进行建模，但具体数据构建细节需要看正文。
summary.authors_note: 作者机构包括 Inner Mongolia University 和 SRIBD；Haizhou Li 是语音与音频方向的知名研究者。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how to use facial-expression information in conversational speech synthesis to generate speech that better matches context and affect.
summary_en.importance: This is a multimodal generation method with a tokenizer component. It is not a general speech-LM pretraining report, but its discretization of facial expressions into tokens connected to an LLM backbone is mildly relevant to unified multimodal tokenization.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors propose FacialTalker, a facial-expression-aware conversational speech synthesis framework. Its key component is AUTokenizer, a single-codebook tokenizer that discretizes frame-level facial expressions into compact tokens, trained with supervision from combinations of facial Action Units. The framework also uses DualDPO to improve preference alignment between generated speech and visual-affective cues.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report training-data scale, model size, baseline names, or exact gains. It motivates the work by the lack of large natural conversational datasets with both speech and visual modalities, but the concrete dataset and evaluation details require the full paper.
summary_en.authors_note: The listed institutions include Inner Mongolia University and SRIBD; Haizhou Li is a well-known researcher in speech and audio.

recommendation.zh: 看 AUTokenizer 设计即可；TTS 应用味较重，pretrain 侧只借鉴表情离散化。
recommendation.en: Only the AUTokenizer design is worth a look; the work is mostly TTS-oriented, with limited pretraining signal beyond affect tokenization.

paper.title: UniGen-AR: Unifying Visual Generation with Auto-Regressive Modeling
paper.abstract: Modern computer vision pipelines remain fragmented, with tasks such as text-to-image generation, editing, restoration, and classical perception handled by separate models. We study Unified Visual Generation (UVG), where a single model produces diverse image-valued outputs through a unified multimodal interface. While diffusion-based systems dominate UVG due to strong quality and controllability, their iterative sampling incurs substantial inference latency, limiting practical deployment. To addr

summary.core_problem: 现有视觉任务（生成、编辑、修复、感知）模型碎片化，扩散类统一视觉生成模型采样延迟高，难以通过单一模型统一接口完成多类视觉输出。
summary.importance: 探索了多模态大语言模型与自回归视觉解码器结合的统一视觉生成范式，相比扩散类方法具备更高采样效率，同时保留MLLM的灵活条件接口能力。
summary.technical_approach: 框架由通用MLLM和next-scale视觉自回归（VAR）解码器两部分组成；MLLM将自由格式指令、控制信号编码为统一序列作为条件，引导VAR解码器通过多尺度自回归生成图像输出，复用VAR模型的潜在空间统一特性。
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露具体实验数值与基线对比结果，仅声称该设计保留MLLM的灵活条件控制能力，相较扩散类统一视觉生成方法大幅降低采样延迟，可支持文生图、图像编辑、图像修复等多类视觉任务。
summary.authors_note: 作者团队来自CMU等机构，Martial Hebert为卡内基梅隆大学机器人研究所知名教授，深耕计算机视觉领域。

summary_en.core_problem: Modern computer vision pipelines are fragmented across generation, editing, restoration, and perception tasks, while diffusion-based unified visual generation models suffer from prohibitive inference latency.
summary_en.importance: Explores an autoregressive alternative to diffusion for unified visual generation, pairing MLLMs with efficient VAR decoders to retain flexible conditioning while reducing sampling latency.
summary_en.technical_approach: The framework consists of a general-purpose MLLM and a next-scale visual autoregressive (VAR) decoder; the MLLM encodes free-form instructions and control signals into a unified conditioning sequence that guides the VAR decoder to generate images via multi-scale autoregressive prediction, leveraging the latent unification property of VAR.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report quantitative benchmark results; the method is claimed to support text-to-image generation, editing, and restoration with significantly lower sampling latency than diffusion-based unified visual generation systems, while preserving MLLM conditioning flexibility.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors include Martial Hebert (Carnegie Mellon University), a leading researcher in computer vision and robotics.

recommendation.zh: 纯CV侧的统一视觉生成pipeline，用现成MLLM接VAR解码器，无预训练或统一建模核心创新，作为多模态生成方向文献备查即可。
recommendation.en: A CV-side unified visual generation pipeline pairing off-the-shelf MLLM with VAR decoder, no core innovation on pretraining or unified modeling; keep as literature reference only.

paper.title: ExpertVerse: A General-Purpose Benchmark for Expert-Level Reasoning in Knowledge-Intensive Visual Synthesis
paper.abstract: Recent advances in multimodal generative models have enabled instruction-based image generation to move beyond semantic manipulation to knowledge-driven visual reasoning. However, these methods focus on explicit commonsense reasoning, shallow causal understanding, and direct knowledge recall, failing at knowledge-intensive generation. We develop \textbf{ExpertVerse}, a capability-centric benchmark to evaluate generative models via knowledge-intensive lens. ExpertVerse stratifies reasoning genera

summary.core_problem: 现有图像生成评测主要覆盖显式常识、浅层因果或知识回忆，难以衡量模型在知识密集型视觉合成中的专家级推理能力。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是评测资产和数据集。ExpertVerse 提供面向知识密集型视觉生成的能力分类、专家标注样本和大规模带推理轨迹的数据，对多模态生成模型的能力边界分析有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 论文构建 9 类认知能力和 8 个专家学科的正交 taxonomy，细分为 58 个子学科，覆盖单图编辑、多图组合和文生图。作者人工标注 1,611 个实例，并通过自动化流程扩展出 ExpertVerse-100K，包含 reasoning traces 和知识锚定 rationale；还基于该数据训练 KnowThinker，并使用 RL 做进一步优化。
summary.experiments: 摘要给出数据规模：1,611 个专家标注实例和 100K 规模的自动生成数据。模型实验包括训练 KnowThinker 并与现有多模态生成模型比较，但摘要截断，未提供具体模型规模、baseline 名称和提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing image-generation evaluations focus on commonsense, shallow causality, or direct recall, and do not adequately test expert-level knowledge-intensive visual synthesis.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an evaluation and dataset contribution. ExpertVerse offers a capability taxonomy, expert-annotated cases, and a larger rationale-annotated corpus for probing knowledge-heavy visual generation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The benchmark organizes tasks along 9 cognitive capabilities and 8 expert disciplines, further split into 58 sub-disciplines. It includes single-image editing, multi-image composition, and text-to-image generation. The authors curate 1,611 expert-annotated instances and build ExpertVerse-100K with reasoning traces and knowledge-grounded rationales, then train KnowThinker with reinforcement learning.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports 1,611 expert-annotated examples and a 100K-scale generated dataset. It mentions training KnowThinker and comparing against multimodal generative models, but the provided abstract does not include model sizes, baselines, or quantitative gains.

recommendation.zh: 这是视觉生成评测资产，不是基座训练论文；作为知识密集型多模态 eval 备查即可。
recommendation.en: This is a visual-generation evaluation asset, not a base-model training paper; keep it as a reference for knowledge-intensive multimodal eval.

paper.title: ShotPlan: Cinematic Video Generation with Learnable Planning Token
paper.abstract: Current video generation models achieve impressive results in single-shot generation, yet remain limited in cinematic video generation, where coherent narratives and effective multi-shot composition require explicit shot planning. To address this challenge, we propose ShotPlan, a framework for explicit multi-shot cinematic video generation built upon a video diffusion foundation model. Our method introduces learnable planning tokens that capture shot-level transition cues and can be seamlessly i

summary.core_problem: 现有视频生成模型仅擅长单镜头生成，在需要连贯叙事和多镜头组合的电影级视频生成上缺乏显式镜头规划能力。
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出显式多镜头电影级视频生成框架，通过可学习规划token实现镜头转场的细粒度控制。
summary.technical_approach: 基于视频扩散基座模型，引入捕捉镜头级转场线索的可学习规划token，与原生生成token融合以控制转场时间戳；为规划token配备分数时间旋转位置编码（FRoPE），实现帧级转场建模。
summary.experiments: 在电影级视频生成任务上显著优于现有方法，镜头管理更灵活，跨镜头一致性更强。
summary.authors_note: Cohere 参与研究。

summary_en.core_problem: Current video generation models excel at single-shot generation but lack explicit shot planning for cinematic video production that requires coherent narratives and multi-shot composition.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation; proposes an explicit multi-shot cinematic video generation framework with learnable planning tokens for fine-grained transition control.
summary_en.technical_approach: Built on a video diffusion foundation model, introduces learnable planning tokens that capture shot-level transition cues and integrate with native generation tokens to control transition timestamps; equips planning tokens with Fractional Temporal Rotary Position Embedding (FRoPE) for frame-level transition modeling.
summary_en.experiments: Significantly outperforms existing cinematic video generation methods, with more flexible shot management and stronger inter-shot consistency.
summary_en.authors_note: Research affiliated with Cohere.

recommendation.zh: 规划token+FRoPE的时序控制思路对长文本多段生成有微弱参考价值，仅看方法节即可，整体属视频生成领域工作。
recommendation.en: Planning token + FRoPE temporal control offers minor inspiration for long-text multi-segment generation; methods section only.

paper.title: MultiRef-Compass: Towards Comprehensive Evaluation of Multi-Reference-to-Audio-Video Generation
paper.abstract: Multi-reference-to-audio-video (MR2AV) generation aims to generate coherent audio-video content conditioned on multiple references and textual instructions. Existing benchmarks mainly focus on text-driven generation, single-reference subject preservation, or isolated audio-video alignment, leaving the emerging MR2AV setting largely unexplored. Compared with these settings, MR2AV requires models to jointly reason over multiple references while generating synchronized visual and audio content. Mod

summary.core_problem: 现有音视频生成评测基准未覆盖多参考条件下的音视频联合生成（MR2AV）场景，无法评估模型对多参考实体的绑定、组合及音视频同步生成能力。
summary.importance: Benchmark贡献，首次构建面向多参考条件音视频生成的统一评测基准，填补了该细分场景的评测空白。
summary.technical_approach: 通过可扩展、可控的资产组合流水线构建350个标注样本，覆盖多视角主体保持、多实体绑定、人-物-场景组合三类核心任务；设计可解释的多维度评测指标，分别评估参考保真度、实体组合一致性、音视频同步性等维度。
summary.experiments: 选取当前主流的多模态生成模型作为基线，在三类子任务上进行系统评测，发现现有模型在多实体绑定与音视频联合一致性上存在明显短板。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自南京大学、新加坡国立大学、香港科技大学（广州）、清华大学、北京大学等高校。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing audio-video generation benchmarks do not cover the multi-reference conditioned audio-video generation (MR2AV) setting, failing to evaluate models' ability to bind and compose multi-reference entities while generating synchronized audio-visual content.
summary_en.importance: A benchmark contribution that first builds a unified evaluation benchmark for multi-reference conditioned audio-video generation, filling the evaluation gap in this emerging scenario.
summary_en.technical_approach: 350 curated samples are constructed via a scalable and controllable asset-composition pipeline, covering three core tasks: multi-view subject preservation, multi-entity binding, and human-object-scene composition. Interpretable multi-dimensional metrics are designed to evaluate reference fidelity, entity composition consistency, and audio-video synchronization.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluates mainstream multimodal generation models as baselines across three subtasks, revealing that existing models have obvious shortcomings in multi-entity binding and joint audio-visual consistency.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors are from Nanjing University, National University of Singapore, Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou), Tsinghua University, Peking University, etc.

recommendation.zh: 仅面向多参考音视频生成细分场景的评测基准，不做多模态统一生成预训练的研究员无需深入。
recommendation.en: A benchmark only for the narrow multi-reference audio-video generation scenario; no need for researchers not working on unified multimodal generative pre-training to dive in.

institutions: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou)

paper.title: Boogu-Image-0.1: Boosting Open-Source Unified Multimodal Understanding and Generation
paper.abstract: We introduce Boogu-Image-0.1, an open-source unified multimodal understanding and generation model family, comprising Base, Turbo, Edit, and Edit-Turbo variants. It delivers competitive performance in high-quality text-to-image generation, fast inference, instruction-based editing, and bilingual (Chinese-English) text rendering. Closed-source multimodal systems like Nano-Banana-Pro and GPT-Image-2 achieve strong performance through system-level integration rather than a single model, yet their i

summary.core_problem: 在有限算力下，如何把开源统一多模态模型同时做成可理解、可生成、可编辑，并尽量逼近闭源图像生成系统的综合能力。
summary.importance: 这是一个统一多模态理解+生成系统工作，价值主要在工程 recipe 和系统整合，而不是新的基座预训练原理。对关注 AR+diffusion 联合建模、统一模态训练管线的人有边缘参考，但摘要里的“agentic inference-time scaling”更像系统技巧而非范式突破。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Boogu-Image-0.1 系列，包括 Base、Turbo、Edit、Edit-Turbo 变体，强调通过模型理解能力增强、数据质量改进、训练 pipeline 调整，以及推理时 agentic scaling 来提升文本生成图像、图像编辑和双语文字渲染表现。摘要没有给出清晰的统一建模细节，因此目前更像一个多组件系统集成，而不是可直接迁移到 LLM pretrain 的新目标函数或架构。
summary.experiments: 论文声称在标准 benchmark 上稳定匹配或超过其他开源模型，并接近领先闭源系统；覆盖高质量文生图、快速推理、指令编辑和中英双语文字渲染。摘要未提供模型规模、训练 token/image 数量、具体 baseline 和提升幅度，因此很难判断哪些收益来自数据、哪些来自 pipeline、哪些来自 inference tricks。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks how to build an open-source unified multimodal model that can understand, generate, and edit images under tight compute budgets while approaching closed-source systems.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly a systems-and-recipe contribution for unified multimodal understanding and generation, not a new foundation-model pretraining principle. It has some peripheral relevance for people interested in unified AR+diffusion-style training pipelines, but the abstract reads more like integration work than a paradigm shift.
summary_en.technical_approach: It introduces the Boogu-Image-0.1 family—Base, Turbo, Edit, and Edit-Turbo—and attributes gains to better model understanding, improved data quality, training-pipeline refinements, and agentic inference-time scaling. The abstract does not reveal enough about the actual unified modeling mechanism, so at this stage it looks more like a multi-component system recipe than a transferable pretraining objective or architecture.
summary_en.experiments: The paper claims competitive or better performance than other open-source models across standard benchmarks, with results approaching strong closed-source systems, covering text-to-image generation, fast inference, instruction-based editing, and bilingual text rendering. The abstract does not provide model size, training data scale, baselines, or exact deltas, making it hard to separate gains from data, training, and inference-time tricks.

recommendation.zh: 更像开源图像系统 recipe 汇总，不像会改变统一建模 prior 的论文；若你做 multimodal pretrain，只需看它如何拆分数据、训练和 inference trick 的贡献。
recommendation.en: This looks more like an open-source image-system recipe than a paper that changes priors on unified modeling; if you work on multimodal pretraining, only inspect how it attributes gains across data, training, and inference tricks.

paper.title: FlashDiff: Efficient Regional Execution and Scheduling for Diffusion Model Serving
paper.abstract: Diffusion models have become the central backbone for modern image, video, and audio generation, but their efficient service remains a challenge. Unlike autoregressive decoding, diffusion inference repeatedly updates high-dimensional spatial or temporal latents over many denoising steps. This all-region execution pattern makes generation latency high and limits serving throughput. Existing multi-GPU parallelization methods can reduce per-step computation, but often introduce substantial activati

summary.core_problem: 解决 diffusion 图像、视频和音频生成服务中，每个 denoising step 都对完整 latent 区域执行计算，导致延迟高、吞吐低，以及多 GPU 并行通信开销抵消计算收益的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是 diffusion serving 系统优化，而不是预训练方法；但它针对 AR decoding 之外的生成式推理形态，能提示统一生成模型 serving 不能直接套用 LLM token-by-token 的优化假设。
summary.technical_approach: FlashDiff 基于一个观察：diffusion refinement 在空间或时间 latent 区域上并不均匀，不同区域稳定速度不同，相邻 denoising steps 之间还有较强时间相关性。系统据此做 adaptive regional execution 和 scheduling，避免对已经稳定的区域重复执行全量更新，并在多 GPU 场景下降低无效计算和 activation exchange 的相对成本。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、数据集和数值结果；只说明其目标是提升 diffusion serving 的 latency 和 throughput，并指出现有多 GPU 并行方法常因 activation exchange overhead 使通信抵消计算收益。

summary_en.core_problem: FlashDiff targets high latency and low throughput in serving diffusion models for image, video, and audio generation, where every denoising step typically updates the full high-dimensional latent.
summary_en.importance: This is a diffusion serving systems paper rather than a pretraining paper. Its relevance is that it studies a non-autoregressive generation workload whose bottlenecks differ from token-by-token LLM decoding.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method exploits the observation that diffusion refinement is spatially or temporally non-uniform: different latent regions stabilize at different rates, and neighboring denoising steps are strongly correlated. FlashDiff uses adaptive regional execution and scheduling to avoid redundant full-region computation and to reduce the impact of activation exchange in multi-GPU execution.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide concrete model sizes, datasets, or numerical speedups. It frames the evaluation around latency and throughput improvements over existing multi-GPU diffusion serving approaches, which can suffer from communication overhead dominating compute savings.

recommendation.zh: 只看系统假设是否成立：regional stabilization 若稳健，未来 AR+diffusion 统一 serving 会用到这个抽象。
recommendation.en: Skim only the system assumption: if regional stabilization is robust, this abstraction may matter for unified AR+diffusion serving.

paper.title: Read It Back: Pretrained MLLMs Are Zero-Shot Reward Models for Text-to-Image Generation
paper.abstract: In this paper, we propose SpectraReward, a training-free reward function that turns pretrained MLLMs into off-the-shelf reward models for image-generation reinforcement learning. Instead of asking the MLLM to judge a generated image or answer decomposed verification questions, SpectraReward measures how well the original prompt can be recovered from the generated image through a single image-conditioned, teacher-forced forward pass. We use the average image-conditioned prompt log-likelihood as t

summary.core_problem: 文生图（含统一多模态模型的图像生成能力）的RL后训练阶段，现有奖励信号存在明显缺陷：基于人类偏好标注训练的奖励模型成本高、迭代慢；零样本使用MLLM做主观打分存在校准差、评分噪声大的问题；基于问题分解的验证方案工程复杂度高。目前缺乏高效、无需额外训练、开箱即用的可靠奖励信号，同时统一多模态模型如何不依赖外部组件、利用自身能力实现闭环自提升，也缺少成熟方案。
summary.importance: 提出的奖励计算方式直接复用预训练阶段的图像条件语言建模目标作为奖励，无需额外偏好标注或奖励模型微调，绕开了传统奖励模型的分布偏移问题。Self-SpectraReward的设计验证了奖励信号与策略模型的分布对齐，其重要性不低于奖励模型的规模——同模型内的对齐信号效果可以超过参数量大数十倍的外部奖励模型，这一发现不仅适用于多模态生成RL，对纯文本RL、自提升模型管线中如何构造无偏内置奖励也有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: SpectraReward是免训练奖励函数：将生成图像输入冻结的预训练MLLM，执行一次教师强制前向传播，计算原始prompt在图像条件下的平均token对数似然，将该值作为标量奖励。整个过程不需要MLLM输出显式的主观评分，也不需要将prompt拆分为原子问题逐一验证，直接复用MLLM预训练获得的图文对齐能力。针对同时集成视觉理解与图像生成的统一多模态模型，进一步设计Self-SpectraReward：直接使用模型自身的理解分支计算上述prompt对数似然，作为自身生成分支的奖励信号，不依赖任何外部模型形成闭环自提升。由于理解分支与生成分支共享tokenizer、视觉编码器和预训练数据分布，两者天然具备分布一致性，避免了外部奖励模型常见的分布偏移问题。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖两个生成骨干（SD3.5-M、BAGEL统一多模态模型）、三种RL算法、9个参数量从4B到235B的MLLM奖励骨干，在5个分布外文生图基准上完成评测：在BAGEL模型上，SpectraReward相对基线在TIIF-Bench上提升10.0分，GenEval上提升4.3分；相对之前的强基线AlphaGRPO，SpectraReward在TIIF-Bench上高6.3分，GenEval上高2.1分。Self-SpectraReward的效果优于使用同规模外部MLLM作为奖励的SpectraReward，甚至与使用4倍到30倍参数量外部MLLM的SpectraReward效果相当或更好——例如相对使用最优外部MLLM骨干的SpectraReward，Self-SpectraReward在GenEval上高1.2分、GenEval2上高2.1分、WISE上高2.0分，验证了奖励与策略的分布对齐的价值不低于奖励模型规模。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时重点关注核心奖励设计思路（教师强制计算prompt对数似然，而非让模型显式打分）、Self-SpectraReward的闭环设计逻辑，以及分布对齐与奖励模型规模的对比实验结论，可跳过RL算法实现的低层细节。预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Reinforcement learning post-training for text-to-image generation (including generation capabilities in unified multimodal models) lacks efficient, training-free, reliable reward signals. Reward models trained on human preference annotations are costly to build and slow to iterate; zero-shot MLLM judges suffer from poor calibration and high scoring noise; question-decomposition based verification pipelines introduce high engineering complexity. There is also no mature approach for unified multimodal models to achieve closed-loop self-improvement using only internal capabilities, without external dependencies.
summary_en.importance: The proposed reward formulation directly reuses the pretrained image-conditioned language modeling objective as a reward signal, eliminating the need for preference annotations or dedicated reward model fine-tuning, and avoiding common distribution shift issues in traditional reward models. The Self-SpectraReward design demonstrates that distributional alignment between reward signal and policy is at least as important as reward model scale: an aligned internal reward can outperform external reward models tens of times larger. This finding is relevant not just for multimodal generation RL, but also for text-only RL and self-improving model pipelines seeking to build unbiased, built-in reward signals.
summary_en.technical_approach: SpectraReward is a training-free reward function that works by passing a generated image to a frozen pretrained MLLM, running a single teacher-forced forward pass on the original text prompt, and using the mean token log-likelihood of the prompt conditioned on the image as the scalar reward. This process requires no explicit scalar judgment from the MLLM, and no decomposition of prompts into atomic verification questions; it directly leverages the image-text alignment capability learned during MLLM pretraining. For unified multimodal models that integrate both visual understanding and image generation in a single architecture, Self-SpectraReward uses the model’s own understanding branch to compute the prompt log-likelihood reward for its generation branch, forming a closed-loop self-improvement pipeline with no external model dependencies. The understanding and generation branches share a tokenizer, vision encoder, and pretraining data distribution, creating natural distributional alignment that avoids shift issues common with external reward models.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluations are conducted across two generator backbones (SD3.5-M, BAGEL unified multimodal model), three RL algorithms, and 9 MLLM reward backbones spanning 4B to 235B parameters, on 5 out-of-distribution text-to-image benchmarks. On the BAGEL model, SpectraReward improves over the base model by +10.0 on TIIF-Bench and +4.3 on GenEval; it outperforms the strong AlphaGRPO baseline by +6.3 on TIIF-Bench and +2.1 on GenEval. Self-SpectraReward outperforms SpectraReward with similarly sized external MLLM backbones, and matches or exceeds performance of SpectraReward using 4x to 30x larger external MLLMs: for example, it delivers +1.2 on GenEval, +2.1 on GenEval2, and +2.0 on WISE over the best-performing external MLLM backbone for SpectraReward, confirming that distributional alignment between reward and policy delivers as much value as increased reward model scale.
summary_en.reading_guide: For skimming, focus on the core reward design choice (prompt log-likelihood under teacher forcing, rather than explicit model scoring), the closed-loop Self-SpectraReward setup, and the experimental result comparing distributional alignment to reward model scale. Low-level RL algorithm implementation details can be skipped. Expected reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法和失败案例：prompt likelihood 当 reward 很干净，但要警惕它学到的是 caption recoverability 而非偏好。
recommendation.en: Read the method and failure cases: prompt likelihood is a clean reward signal, but it may optimize caption recoverability rather than human preference.

paper.title: Next-Dense-Stride Prediction for Multimodal Autoregressive Visual Modeling
paper.abstract: We introduce DenseAR, a new generative paradigm that reformulates autoregressive image generation as coarse-to-fine next-dense-stride prediction using a compact single-scale tokenizer. Our key insight is that traversing a single-scale latent grid with progressively denser strides naturally captures the transition from global structure to fine detail. This addresses two limitations of existing autoregressive models at once: the slow inference of raster-order autoregression, which DenseAR avoids b

summary.core_problem: DenseAR 解决的是视觉自回归生成里的顺序设计问题：raster-order 单尺度 token 序列短，但必须逐 token 解码；VAR 式 next-scale 生成有粗到细结构，但需要多尺度 token 栈，序列长度和显存开销明显增加。论文试图在单尺度视觉 tokenizer 上保留粗到细生成，同时减少解码步数和多模态任务中的序列膨胀。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在建模范式，而不是单个视觉任务结果。它把粗到细生成从 tokenizer 结构中解耦出来，改由预测顺序实现：同一个 latent grid 可以先预测稀疏位置，再逐步填密。这个想法对统一多模态 LM 有参考意义，因为多尺度视觉表示在图像条件生成、编辑、医学多模态输入时会快速放大上下文长度；如果单尺度 grid 能提供可控的层级生成顺序，AR 视觉建模的训练和推理成本都会更容易管理。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是 next-dense-stride prediction。模型仍使用紧凑的单尺度 VQ token grid，而不是像 VAR 那样为一张图构造多个分辨率的 token map。生成时不按 raster 顺序逐点预测，而是把 grid 按 stride 分成若干组：先预测间隔大的稀疏 token，用来确定全局布局；之后逐步减小 stride，填充更密的位置，用来补充局部细节。同一 stride 内的多个 token 可以并行预测，因此解码步数由 stride 层数决定，而不是由 grid token 数决定。论文还把这个框架扩展到统一医学影像模型：多对比 MRI 合成、跨模态翻译、分割共用一个 AR backbone。条件控制上使用 task-conditional classifier-free guidance，不为不同任务额外引入独立组件，而是通过任务条件调节模型对源模态的依赖强度。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖自然图像和医学影像两个场景：ImageNet 生成用于验证 DenseAR 在通用图像生成上的质量和效率；多对比脑 MRI 用于验证单模型覆盖多对比合成、跨模态翻译和分割的可行性。提供内容没有给出具体 FID、IS、Dice、推理步数、参数量或训练数据规模数字，因此不宜补写数值结论。可确定的实验设计重点是与两类视觉 AR 路线对比：单尺度 raster AR 的逐 token 慢解码，以及 next-scale/VAR 类方法的长多尺度序列开销。消融最应关注 stride 调度、单尺度 tokenizer 重建质量、并行预测粒度、task-conditional CFG 强度对不同任务的影响。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 20–30 分钟。先看 Introduction 和 Figure 1，确认论文怎样把“粗到细”从多尺度 tokenizer 转移到预测顺序。再看 Background 中对 VQ-VAE 单尺度 grid 与 VAR 多尺度 token 栈的对比，这部分决定了 DenseAR 的成本优势是否成立。方法部分重点看 stride 分组、注意力 mask、训练目标、同一 stride 内 token 是否条件独立，以及推理时的并行化实现。实验部分优先找三类表格：ImageNet 质量/速度对比、医学多任务统一模型结果、CFG 和 stride schedule 消融。若只关心 LLM 预训练，可重点思考它对“视觉 token 顺序”与“统一上下文长度控制”的启发。

summary_en.core_problem: DenseAR addresses the ordering problem in autoregressive visual generation. Raster-order AR keeps a compact single-scale latent grid but decodes one token at a time. VAR-style next-scale AR obtains coarse-to-fine generation, but represents each image as a stack of multi-resolution token maps, which increases sequence length and memory cost. The paper tries to keep coarse-to-fine generation while using a single-scale tokenizer and far fewer decoding steps.
summary_en.importance: The useful part for pretraining research is the modeling choice, not a downstream medical application. DenseAR separates hierarchical generation from hierarchical tokenization. A single latent grid is traversed in a sparse-to-dense order, so the model can first set global structure and then fill in local details. This matters for unified multimodal modeling because multi-scale visual token stacks become expensive when multiple images, source modalities, or task conditions are placed in the same context. A single-grid ordering scheme is a cleaner fit for AR-style unified models.
summary_en.technical_approach: The core method is next-dense-stride prediction. The image is encoded into a compact single-scale VQ token grid. Instead of flattening the grid in raster order, DenseAR partitions positions by progressively denser strides. It first predicts widely spaced tokens, then fills in intermediate positions with smaller strides. Tokens within the same stride group are predicted in parallel, so generation takes a small number of stages rather than one step per grid token. The paper also extends the same backbone to multi-contrast brain MRI synthesis, cross-modal translation, and segmentation. Conditioning is handled with task-conditional classifier-free guidance, which lets the model tune how strongly it follows source modalities for each task without adding separate task-specific modules.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments cover ImageNet generation and multi-contrast brain MRI. ImageNet is used to test whether sparse-to-dense AR can remain competitive on natural image generation. The MRI setting tests whether a single AR backbone can handle synthesis, translation, and segmentation together. The provided text does not include concrete numbers for FID, IS, Dice, decoding latency, parameter count, or training scale, so numerical claims should be checked in the tables. The key comparisons to inspect are against raster-order single-scale AR, which is slow at inference, and next-scale AR, which pays for long multi-resolution token sequences. The most informative ablations should be stride schedules, tokenizer resolution, parallel prediction group size, and task-conditional guidance strength.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20–30 minute skim is enough for most LLM pretraining readers. Start with the introduction and Figure 1 to understand how the paper moves coarse-to-fine structure from the tokenizer into the generation order. Then read the background comparison between VQ-VAE single-scale grids and VAR multi-scale token stacks. In the method section, focus on stride grouping, attention masking, the training objective, and whether tokens inside one stride are modeled independently given earlier strides. In the experiments, prioritize ImageNet quality/speed comparisons, the unified MRI multi-task table, and ablations on stride schedule and classifier-free guidance.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法和并行解码分析即可；它像是在视觉 token 顺序上做 clean ablation，值得借鉴到统一 AR 多模态建模。
recommendation.en: Read the method and parallel decoding analysis; the useful signal is a clean rethink of visual token order for unified AR multimodal models.

paper.title: Xiaomi-Robotics-U0: Unified Embodied Synthesis with World Foundation Model
paper.abstract: Recent foundation image and video generation models offer strong generalization and controllability, but their direct application to embodied scenarios is limited by requirements for multi-view consistency, geometric coherence, and robot embodiment constraints. Existing methods typically adapt foundation models with limited robot data, often sacrificing visual knowledge acquired during large-scale pre-training. We present Xiaomi-Robotics-U0, a 38-billion-parameter multimodal autoregressive model

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是通用图像/视频生成模型迁移到机器人场景时的失配问题：自然图像生成只需要视觉上合理，而具身生成还要求多视角一致、几何连贯、机器人本体约束和时间动态一致。作者的核心做法不是把基础生成模型窄化成机器人专用模型，而是把具身合成放回统一的多模态生成预训练框架里。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练研究的启发主要在两点。第一，它把机器人数据合成看成统一世界模型训练的一部分，而不是下游适配任务，这对多模态预训练的数据配比和任务设计有参考意义。第二，它强调继续训练时必须保留通用图像/视频生成任务，否则小规模、重复性强的机器人数据会削弱基础模型原有的语义和可控生成能力。贡献量级更偏系统整合和训练范式验证，不是新的语言建模目标。
summary.technical_approach: Xiaomi-Robotics-U0 是一个 38B 参数的多模态自回归模型。它从已有 world foundation model 出发，在通用域数据和具身数据上做联合继续训练，统一优化 text-to-image、image editing、embodied scene generation、embodied transfer 和 embodied video generation。关键取舍是：不只用机器人轨迹继续训练，因为这会造成能力遗忘；也不只做单步场景生成，因为机器人策略需要可 rollout 的时序数据。论文进一步把 interleaved embodied sequences 和 manipulation videos 放到多时间分辨率下联合建模，用同一自回归框架同时覆盖静态多视角场景、结构化编辑迁移和视频 rollout。这个设计更像 Chameleon/Emu3/Janus 一类 unified autoregressive multimodal modeling 在机器人世界模型上的延伸。
summary.experiments: 论文给出的主要结果包括：在 embodied scene generation 和 embodied transfer 的人工评测中优于 GPT-Image-2.0；在 World Arena benchmark 上取得较强结果；生成数据能提升下游机器人策略的 out-of-distribution robustness。给定全文片段没有提供具体分数、胜率、数据规模、tokenizer 细节和训练配比，因此这些结论需要在实验表格中核对。对预训练研究更有信息量的实验不是视觉样例，而是：联合训练是否优于机器人数据单独继续训练，通用生成能力是否被保留，生成轨迹加入策略训练后在 OOD 条件下的提升幅度。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 30–45 分钟。重点看三类内容：一是模型输入输出表示和自回归序列化方式，特别是图像、视频、多视角和机器人状态如何被组织成同一序列；二是训练数据与任务 mixture，尤其是通用生成任务和具身任务的比例、采样策略、loss 权重；三是 ablation，确认联合继续训练是否真的缓解遗忘，并带来机器人策略收益。定性图可以快速浏览，不应作为主要判断依据。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a concrete mismatch between foundation image/video generators and embodied generation. Natural image generation only needs plausible visual outputs, while robotic scenarios require multi-view consistency, geometric coherence, embodiment constraints, and temporally consistent interaction dynamics. The proposed direction is to treat embodied synthesis as part of unified multimodal generative pretraining, rather than as a narrow robot-only adaptation stage.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance to pretraining is the training recipe and task formulation. The work argues that robot-world modeling should remain coupled with general image and video generation tasks during continual training, because robot datasets are smaller, more repetitive, and less diverse than web-scale visual corpora. This is a useful lesson for multimodal foundation model training: domain specialization can easily trade away the broad controllability and semantic coverage that made the base model useful. The contribution is mainly a large-system formulation and empirical validation, not a new modeling objective.
summary_en.technical_approach: Xiaomi-Robotics-U0 is described as a 38B multimodal autoregressive model. It starts from a world foundation model and continues training on both general-domain and embodied datasets under one autoregressive objective. The task mixture includes text-to-image generation, image editing, embodied scene generation, embodied transfer, and embodied video generation. The important design choice is to avoid robot-only finetuning, which may cause capability forgetting, and to go beyond single-step scene synthesis by modeling interleaved embodied sequences and manipulation videos at multiple temporal resolutions. In spirit, it extends unified autoregressive multimodal modeling, as seen in systems such as Chameleon, Emu3, and Janus, into robot-centric world modeling.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports stronger human preference results than GPT-Image-2.0 on embodied scene generation and embodied transfer, strong performance on the World Arena benchmark, and improved out-of-distribution robustness for downstream robot policies when generated data is used. The provided content does not include exact scores, win rates, dataset sizes, tokenizer details, or mixture ratios. The most informative results to verify are the ablations: joint general-plus-embodied training versus robot-only continual training, preservation of general generation ability, and the magnitude of downstream policy gains from synthetic trajectories.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 30–45 minutes. Focus on the representation and serialization scheme for images, videos, multi-view observations, and robot-conditioned inputs; the data and task mixture used during continual training; and the ablation tables around forgetting, embodied generation quality, and policy improvement. Qualitative galleries are useful for sanity checks but should not drive the main assessment.

recommendation.zh: 38B统一具身生成的系统工作，参考其多任务联合训练设置，以及复用通用预训练能力适配具身约束的设计思路。
recommendation.en: 38B unified embodied synthesis system work; reference its multi-task joint training setup and design for adapting general pretrained generation capabilities to embodied constraints.

paper.title: ABot-3DWorld 0: A Universal World Model to Explore Any 3D Space
paper.abstract: We present ABot-3DWorld 0, a universal multimodal 3D world model that turns text, image, and video inputs into high-fidelity, explorable 3D worlds. At the heart of our framework is a unified Spatial Generative Primitive (SGP), a compact tuple of a high-quality panorama and a spatial point cloud that delivers an efficient description of any 3D space. Multimodal inputs are first lifted into this primitive; a 3D-consistent panoramic video generator then explores the primitive along a planned trajec

summary.core_problem: 把文本、图像、视频等输入统一转成可探索、可重建的 3D 世界。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态 3D 生成系统。它尝试用统一的中间空间表示连接输入理解、视频生成和 3DGS 重建，对“世界模型”和跨模态生成接口有参考价值，但离 LLM 基座预训练仍是间接相关。
summary.technical_approach: 核心是 Spatial Generative Primitive，一个由高质量全景图和空间点云组成的紧凑 tuple。系统先把多模态输入 lift 到 SGP；再用 3D-consistent panoramic video generator 沿规划轨迹探索该 primitive；最后通过 panoramic video reconstruction engine 转成 photorealistic 3D Gaussian Splatting 世界。多视角或视频输入走几何恢复路径，单图或文本输入走生成补全路径。
summary.experiments: 摘要强调可覆盖 rich inputs 和 single image/text 两类 regime，并生成高保真、可探索 3DGS 世界；未提供模型参数、训练数据、baseline、用户研究或定量指标。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper aims to turn text, images, and videos into explorable 3D worlds through a unified world-modeling pipeline.
summary_en.importance: This is a multimodal 3D generation system contribution. Its main value is the intermediate representation that links input understanding, video generation, and 3DGS reconstruction. It is relevant to world-model interfaces, but only indirectly relevant to LLM pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The central object is the Spatial Generative Primitive, a compact tuple consisting of a high-quality panorama and a spatial point cloud. Inputs are lifted into this primitive; a 3D-consistent panoramic video generator explores it along planned trajectories; a panoramic video reconstruction engine then converts the generated video into a clean photorealistic 3D Gaussian Splatting world. Rich inputs use geometry-grounded recovery, while a single image or text prompt is generatively completed.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims coverage of both rich-input and single-image/text regimes and high-fidelity explorable 3DGS outputs. It does not provide model size, training data, baselines, user studies, or quantitative gains in the supplied text.

recommendation.zh: 可作 3D world-model 接口备查；只读 SGP 表示设计即可，别把它当成语言模型范式信号。
recommendation.en: Useful as a reference for 3D world-model interfaces; read the SGP representation design, but do not treat it as an LM-paradigm signal.

paper.title: Beyond Time Shifts: Adapting Omni-LLM as a Reference-Free Evaluator for Generative Audio-Visual Models
paper.abstract: As audio-visual generative models evolve into world simulators, cross-modal synchronization stands as a critical proxy for assessing the consistency of world dynamics and causality in generated content. However, existing evaluation metrics presume structural correctness, reducing synchronization to mere temporal alignment. Consequently, they fail on generative outputs, especially when exhibiting structural hallucinations and asymmetric cross-modal relations, which currently \textbf{mandate exper

summary.core_problem: 解决生成式音视频模型同步性评估过度依赖时间对齐、无法处理结构性幻觉与非对称跨模态关系、且常需人工标注的问题。
summary.importance: 核心贡献是评测方法与评测数据：把人类相对偏好蒸馏成参考无关的连续评分器，并构建 SynthSync 数据集。对做原生多模态预训练的人有间接价值，因为它触及“世界一致性”而不只是时间对齐。
summary.technical_approach: 作者先收集生成失败样本并用成对人工比较形成排序数据集 SynthSync，再把 Omni-LLM 改造成 reference-free evaluator，学习从相对人类判断中得到全局一致的连续同步分数。重点不是生成模型本身，而是评估器如何覆盖结构错误、幻觉和跨模态因果不对称。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模，但实验主线应是：与传统时间偏移/对齐类指标比较，在含结构性错误的生成音视频上更贴近人工判断；同时验证 evaluator 在 reference-free 设定下的稳定性与泛化。对预训练研究员的价值主要在 metric 设计，而非模型训练细节。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自浙江大学、香港理工大学等机构；未见顶级基础模型实验室背景，但题目聚焦多模态生成评测。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the failure of existing audio-visual synchronization metrics on generative outputs, especially when structural hallucinations and asymmetric cross-modal relations make simple temporal alignment insufficient.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is evaluation: a reference-free metric distilled from human pairwise judgments, plus the SynthSync dataset. This is indirectly useful for native multimodal pretraining because it targets world-consistency rather than mere time shift alignment.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors build SynthSync from generative failure cases ranked by pairwise human annotations, then adapt an Omni-LLM into a reference-free evaluator that maps relative human preferences into a globally consistent continuous synchronization score. The emphasis is on handling structural errors, hallucinations, and asymmetric audio-visual dependencies.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model sizes, but the likely experimental core is comparison against time-shift/alignment metrics on generated audio-visual content, showing better agreement with human judgments under structural failures. For pretraining researchers, the value lies in metric design rather than training details.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Zhejiang University, Hong Kong Polytechnic University, and collaborators. No major foundation-model lab is evident from the provided metadata, but the work is squarely about multimodal generation evaluation.

recommendation.zh: 做原生多模态预训练的人可以看评测设定：它提醒你“同步”不等于 time shift；但先读数据构造和人类一致性，模型细节可后放。
recommendation.en: Worth a look if you train native multimodal models: it usefully separates synchronization from mere time shift, but read the dataset construction and human-agreement sections first, not the evaluator internals.

institutions: This work was conducted in collaboration with IROOTECH TECHNOLOGY

paper.title: Introducing GPT-Live
paper.abstract: A new generation of voice models for natural human-AI interaction, now powering ChatGPT Voice.

summary.core_problem: 发布新一代语音模型 GPT-Live，用于更自然、低延迟的人机语音交互。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究员的价值不在产品本身，而在它通常意味着语音 tokenization、流式建模、端到端语音生成/理解耦合、实时对话控制等方向有新工程结论。语音 LM 正在从离线 TTS/ASR 管线转向统一交互模型，这和多模态统一预训练直接相关。
summary.technical_approach: 摘要没有给出技术细节，但从“voice models for natural human-AI interaction”看，重点很可能是面向实时对话的语音生成与理解一体化建模，包括低时延 streaming、韵律与轮次控制、可能的 speech token 离散化或直接声学建模，以及与 ChatGPT 对话系统的联动。
summary.experiments: 目前是产品发布口径，没有公开模型参数、训练数据、baseline 或系统级 ablation。若后续伴随技术报告，值得重点看延迟-自然度-可控性的 trade-off、是否采用离散 codec token、以及是否统一文本与语音 token 空间。
summary.authors_note: OpenAI Research / ChatGPT Voice 相关团队。OpenAI 在语音交互上已有 Advanced Voice Mode 等产品积累，这次发布更像一轮模型与系统栈升级。

summary_en.core_problem: GPT-Live introduces a new generation of voice models aimed at more natural and low-latency human-AI spoken interaction.
summary_en.importance: The research value is not the product announcement itself, but the likely underlying lessons on speech tokenization, streaming generation, end-to-end speech interaction, and real-time control. Speech LM is moving from pipeline-style ASR/TTS toward unified interactive modeling, which matters for multimodal pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The abstract gives no technical details, but the framing suggests an integrated speech generation-and-understanding stack for real-time dialogue, likely involving low-latency streaming, prosody and turn-taking control, and possibly discrete speech tokens or direct acoustic modeling tied to the ChatGPT dialogue stack.
summary_en.experiments: This is a product-facing announcement without public model size, training data, baselines, or ablations. If a technical report follows, the key things to inspect are latency-naturalness-controllability trade-offs, whether codec tokens are used, and whether text and speech share a unified token space.
summary_en.authors_note: OpenAI Research / ChatGPT Voice-related teams. OpenAI has prior product experience with advanced voice interaction, so this likely reflects a substantial model-and-systems stack update.

recommendation.zh: 先当产品信号看：正文信息不会多，但它提示 OpenAI 在实时语音 LM 上可能有新 recipe；等技术报告，一定先查 tokenization、streaming 和 turn-taking 设计。
recommendation.en: Treat this as a product signal for now: the post itself will be thin, but it likely hints at a new recipe for real-time speech LM; when the report lands, inspect tokenization, streaming, and turn-taking first.

paper.title: World Narrative Model for Highly Controllable Video Generation: A Paradigm Shift from Pixel Sampling to Physical World Orchestration
paper.abstract: The fundamental obstacle to industrial grade video generation is the lack of controllability: existing models treat video as a pixel distribution sampling problem, bypassing the explicit, instance level $4D$ $(3D + T)$ physical world. Consequently, content creators cannot specify geometry, motion, camera parameters, or lighting in a deterministic, quantitative way, leading to the infamous ''gacha'' loop that makes professional content creation prohibitively inefficient and expensive. To address

summary.core_problem: 现有视频生成模型将任务视为像素分布采样，跳过显式4D物理世界建模，导致几何、运动、相机、光照等维度可控性不足，专业创作效率极低。
summary.importance: 范式创新尝试，提出将视频生成从端到端像素采样解耦为结构化物理叙事编排+像素渲染两阶段的World Narrative Model范式。
summary.technical_approach: 通过协作Agent将文本、参考视频、草图等稀疏多模态输入转换为可编辑的4D世界表示（含场景几何、物体布局、角色骨骼等），再进行像素级渲染，替代黑盒端到端采样。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、训练数据及量化对比结果。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing video generation models treat the task as pixel distribution sampling and skip explicit 4D physical world modeling, resulting in insufficient controllability over geometry, motion, camera, and lighting for professional content creation.
summary_en.importance: Paradigm innovation attempt: proposes the World Narrative Model that decouples video generation into structured physical narrative orchestration and pixel rendering, replacing end-to-end black-box sampling.
summary_en.technical_approach: Uses collaborative agents to translate sparse multimodal inputs (text, reference videos, sketches) into an editable 4D world representation (scene geometry, object layouts, character skeletons, etc.), followed by pixel-level rendering.
summary_en.experiments: No specific model scale, training data, or quantitative comparison results are provided in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 视频生成可控性的思路可参考，但缺少实验验证，作为多模态统一建模的备选范式备查即可。
recommendation.en: The controllability idea for video generation is worth noting, but lacks experimental validation; keep as a reference for alternative multimodal modeling paradigms.

paper.title: OTCache: Optimal Transport for Geometry-Aware Caching in Diffusion Models
paper.abstract: We propose OTCache, a training-free framework for accelerating diffusion sampling via caching schedule prediction. Existing graph-based caching methods reduce redundant computation by optimizing shortest-path objectives, but rely on an additive independence assumption, which often breaks down in the low NFE regime. To address this issue, OTCache models caching schedules across inference budgets as a smooth evolution in policy space, inspired by Optimal Transport (OT). The framework consists of t

summary.core_problem: 现有扩散模型基于图的缓存加速方法依赖加性独立假设，在低采样步数(NFE) regime下该假设失效导致加速效果下降。
summary.importance: 推理加速方法创新，提出训练无关的最优传输视角缓存调度预测框架，适用于图像/视频扩散模型的低步数采样场景。
summary.technical_approach: OTCache分三阶段：保守预算下用图方法得到高保真参考调度、极端低预算下用Optuna搜索锚定调度、用最优传输启发的分位数插值在参考与锚定间预测任意目标预算的调度。
summary.experiments: 在FLUX.1 [dev]、Qwen-Image、HunyuanVideo三个图像/视频扩散模型上验证，在相同感知质量下降低采样步数或提升生成质量。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing graph-based caching acceleration methods for diffusion models rely on an additive independence assumption that breaks down in the low NFE (number of function evaluations) regime, degrading acceleration performance.
summary_en.importance: Inference acceleration method innovation; proposes a training-free optimal transport-inspired caching schedule prediction framework applicable to low-step sampling for image/video diffusion models.
summary_en.technical_approach: OTCache operates in three stages: obtain a high-fidelity reference schedule via graph-based caching under a conservative budget, search for an anchor schedule under extreme low-budget via Optuna optimization with end-to-end perceptual objectives, and predict schedules for arbitrary target budgets via quantile interpolation between reference and anchor using continuous warping representations.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on three image/video diffusion models: FLUX.1 [dev], Qwen-Image, and HunyuanVideo; reduces required sampling steps or improves generation quality under matched perceptual quality.

recommendation.zh: 做多模态生成推理优化的可看§3插值设计，纯LLM预训练研究员仅需知道扩散采样缓存有OT视角的新解法，不必读正文。
recommendation.en: Multimodal generation inference optimization researchers may check §3 interpolation design; pure LLM pretraining researchers only need to be aware of this OT-based diffusion caching approach, no full read needed.

paper.title: Quality-Aware Modulation for Diffusion Transformers
paper.abstract: Modern text-to-image diffusion models, such as diffusion transformers (DiT), rely on timestep or prompt embeddings to modulate the strength of the denoising process in each timestep. While this modulation communicates the current noise level, it does not provide any quality-aware information, which can lead to generated images that are unaligned, visually inconsistent, and lacking in fidelity. In this paper, we propose the Quality Representation Module (QRM), a lightweight transformer module tha

summary.core_problem: 现有文生图扩散Transformer（DiT）仅依赖时间步或提示嵌入调制去噪过程，缺乏质量感知信号，导致生成图像对齐差、一致性弱、保真度不足
summary.importance: 多模态生成领域的方法创新，提出轻量质量感知调制模块，无需改动扩散骨干与采样调度即可提升生成质量
summary.technical_approach: 提出质量表示模块（QRM），基于DiT现有输入学习质量感知向量M_qrm，用其调整Transformer块内的自适应LayerNorm调制，注入质量敏感信号；模块参数量小，不修改主干结构与采样流程
summary.experiments: 给定摘要未披露具体模型规模、训练数据集及基准指标提升幅度，仅提及完成QRM损失函数、架构消融，验证了生成质量的一致性提升

summary_en.core_problem: Existing text-to-image Diffusion Transformers (DiT) only use timestep or prompt embeddings to modulate denoising, lacking quality-aware signals, resulting in misaligned, inconsistent, and low-fidelity generated images
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation in multimodal generation; a lightweight quality-aware modulation module that improves output quality without modifying the diffusion backbone or sampling schedule
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Quality Representation Module (QRM) that learns quality-aware vectors M_qrm from existing DiT inputs, which adjust adaptive LayerNorm modulation inside Transformer blocks to inject quality-sensitive signals; minimal parameter overhead, no changes to backbone or sampling pipeline
summary_en.experiments: No specific model scale, training dataset, or benchmark metric gains are disclosed in the provided abstract; only reports QRM loss/architecture ablations and consistent generation quality improvements

recommendation.zh: DiT块调制的增量改进，对多模态统一建模的条件注入有弱参考，仅看方法章节的调制设计即可
recommendation.en: Incremental improvement to DiT block modulation; weak reference for conditional injection in unified multimodal modeling, only check the modulation design in method section

paper.title: Goku: A Million-Scale Universal Dataset and Benchmark for Instruction-Based Video Editing
paper.abstract: Existing instruction-based video editing datasets commonly focus on single-task appearance editing, failing to meet the complex creative demands of real-world scenarios. To bridge this gap, we present Goku, a large-scale dataset featuring 2 million high-quality, instruction-aligned video editing pairs, which is the first to extend task boundaries from basic appearance editing to multi-task and structural manipulations(e.g., precise control of subject movement). To tackle the data synthesis chall

summary.core_problem: 现有指令驱动视频编辑（IVE）数据集多局限于单任务和外观层面的修改（如物体移除、属性替换），缺乏对多任务、结构形变（如相机运动、主体运动）及参考引导编辑等复杂真实场景的支持。
summary.importance: 构建了迄今为止规模最大、任务最全面的指令视频编辑数据集 Goku，首次将任务边界扩展至结构和多任务编辑，并提出了配套的基准测试和模型，为复杂视频编辑研究提供了重要的数据基础设施。
summary.technical_approach: 1. 数据集构建：设计了可扩展的自动化数据生成 pipeline，将复杂编辑指令分解为可控的子问题，并利用特定任务的专家模型处理。2. 质量控制：引入基于 Gemini2.5-Pro 的渐进式过滤系统，在指令对齐、帧间稳定性和感知真实感三个维度进行过滤，确保数据质量。3. 模型设计：提出 Goku-Edit，采用 MLLM 作为文本编码器，并引入额外的掩码预测分支增强空间定位能力，使主分支更专注于细粒度外观细节。4. 评测基准：建立 Goku-Bench，包含 1000 个测试用例和 7 个专门指标，并经过人工验证。
summary.experiments: Goku 数据集包含 200 万对高质量视频编辑数据。在 Goku-Bench 上的实验表明，Goku-Edit 模型在指令遵循方面比现有 SOTA 模型提升了高达 8%。
summary.reading_guide: 建议重点关注第 3 节关于复杂编辑指令分解和渐进式过滤系统的设计，以及第 4 节 Goku-Edit 模型中掩码预测分支的具体实现。这对于理解如何构建高质量复杂视频编辑数据和提升模型空间定位能力有启发。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing instruction-based video editing (IVE) datasets are mostly limited to single-task and appearance-level modifications (e.g., object removal, attribute replacement), lacking support for complex real-world scenarios such as multi-task editing, structural deformations (e.g., camera movement, subject movement), and reference-guided editing.
summary_en.importance: Introduces Goku, the largest and most comprehensive IVE dataset to date, extending the task boundaries to structural and multi-task editing for the first time. It also provides a corresponding benchmark and model, serving as a crucial data infrastructure for complex video editing research.
summary_en.technical_approach: 1. Dataset Construction: Designs a scalable and automated data generation pipeline that decomposes complex editing instructions into controllable sub-problems, handled by task-specific expert models. 2. Quality Control: Introduces a progressive filtering system powered by Gemini2.5-Pro to filter data across instruction alignment, frame-to-frame stability, and perceptual photorealism. 3. Model Design: Proposes Goku-Edit, which uses an MLLM as the text encoder and incorporates an additional mask prediction branch to enhance spatial grounding, allowing the main branch to focus on fine-grained appearance details. 4. Benchmark: Establishes Goku-Bench with 1,000 test cases and 7 specialized metrics, all human-verified.
summary_en.experiments: The Goku dataset contains 2 million high-quality video editing pairs. Experiments on Goku-Bench show that the Goku-Edit model achieves up to an 8% improvement in instruction following compared to existing SOTA models.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3 for the design of complex editing instruction decomposition and the progressive filtering system, and Section 4 for the specific implementation of the mask prediction branch in the Goku-Edit model. These provide insights into constructing high-quality complex video editing data and improving model spatial grounding.

recommendation.zh: 把它当“视频编辑预训练数据工程手册”：重点看合成分解+渐进过滤的可靠性设计；模型结构部分先别太当真，等看清baseline与协议。
recommendation.en: Treat it as a playbook for video-editing pretraining data: focus on task decomposition + progressive filtering for reliability; be cautious about model claims until baselines/protocols are clear.

paper.title: Qwen-Image-2.0-RL Technical Report
paper.abstract: We present Qwen-Image-2.0-RL, a post-training pipeline that applies reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) and on-policy distillation (OPD) to improve both the visual quality and instruction-following capability of the Qwen-Image-2.0 diffusion model. To provide reliable reward signals, we construct task-specific composite reward models by fine-tuning vision-language models with a pointwise scoring paradigm and chain-of-thought reasoning. For text-to-image generation, the reward models

summary.core_problem: 解决扩散生成模型（Qwen-Image-2.0）的视觉质量与指令跟随能力难以兼顾，RLHF落地缺乏可靠奖励信号与稳定训练策略的问题。
summary.importance: 顶级机构的工业级技术报告，贡献类型包括系统创新（可扩展的扩散模型RLHF训练框架）、数据/奖励模型设计（多维度复合奖励模型、prompt筛选策略），为生成式大模型的后训练对齐提供落地参考。
summary.technical_approach: 1）构建任务特异性复合奖励模型：用带点式打分与CoT推理的VLM微调，覆盖文本生成的对齐/美学/人脸保真、图像编辑的指令跟随/人脸保存维度；2）提出基于GRPO的可扩展RL训练框架，结合混合CFG策略保留预训练知识、组内奖励范围筛选做prompt提纯、逐类别奖励权重校准；3）用任务感知参数融合合并各任务专精的RL checkpoint。
summary.experiments: 基于Qwen-Image-2.0扩散基座做训练，覆盖文本到图像、图像编辑两类任务，主观与客观评测均显著优于基线RLHF方案与原生基座。
summary.authors_note: 阿里巴巴Qwen（通义千问）团队，核心负责多模态生成大模型的研发与迭代。

summary_en.core_problem: Addresses the trade-off between visual quality and instruction following in diffusion generative models (Qwen-Image-2.0), and the lack of reliable reward signals and stable training recipes for diffusion RLHF deployment.
summary_en.importance: Industrial-grade technical report from a top-tier institution; contributions include system innovation (scalable diffusion RLHF training framework), reward/data design (multi-dimensional composite reward models, prompt curation strategy), providing deployment references for post-training alignment of generative foundation models.
summary_en.technical_approach: 1) Builds task-specific composite reward models by fine-tuning VLMs with pointwise scoring and CoT reasoning, covering alignment/aesthetics/portrait fidelity for T2I, and instruction following/face identity preservation for editing; 2) Proposes a scalable GRPO-based RL training framework with hybrid CFG to preserve pretrained knowledge, intra-group reward range filtering for prompt curation, and per-category reward weight calibration; 3) Merges task-specialized RL checkpoints via task-aware parameter fusion.
summary_en.experiments: Trained on Qwen-Image-2.0 diffusion backbone, covering text-to-image and image editing tasks; both subjective and objective evaluations significantly outperform baseline RLHF methods and the original foundation model.
summary_en.authors_note: Qwen team of Alibaba Group, responsible for R&D and iteration of multimodal generative foundation models.

recommendation.zh: 扩散模型RLHF的工业级落地方案，混合CFG保留预训练知识、组内奖励筛选的设计可直接复用至多模态生成的后训练ablation。
recommendation.en: Industrial-grade RLHF deployment pipeline for diffusion models; hybrid CFG for pretrained knowledge preservation and intra-group reward filtering are directly reusable for multimodal generative post-training ablations.

paper.title: HybridCodec: Modeling Discrete and Continuous Representations for Efficient Speech Language Models
paper.abstract: Discrete audio representations have become increasingly popular for building multimodal text-audio systems and integrating audio capabilities into Large Language Models (LLMs). However, numerous studies report performance degradation on various downstream tasks due to information loss during discretization. To address this, we propose a novel approach combining temporally compressed discrete tokens with dimensionality-reduced continuous residuals. Our framework consists of a hybridized discrete-

summary.core_problem: 现有语音LM采用纯离散音频表示，离散化过程丢失细粒度声学信息（如说话人特征），且高时间分辨率导致自回归推理步数多、效率低
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出离散+连续混合的语音表示框架，同时提升语音生成的保真度和推理效率，为语音LM的表示设计提供新思路
summary.technical_approach: 提出HybridCodec：包含混合离散-连续焦点调制codec，将时间压缩的离散token与降维的连续残差结合；搭配混合Transformer，在离散域执行自回归推理，连续残差采用非自回归预测+上采样恢复
summary.experiments: 实验表明，相比纯离散表示方法，该框架显著提升说话人特征保留能力，同时减少所需自回归推理步数
summary.authors_note: 含语音开源框架SpeechBrain核心作者Mirco Ravanelli团队研究成果

summary_en.core_problem: Existing speech LMs use fully discrete audio representations, which lose fine-grained acoustic information (e.g., speaker characteristics) during discretization, and require many autoregressive steps due to high temporal resolution
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: proposes a hybrid discrete-continuous speech representation framework that improves both speech generation fidelity and inference efficiency, providing new ideas for speech LM representation design
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces HybridCodec: a hybrid discrete-continuous focal modulation codec that combines temporally compressed discrete tokens with dimensionality-reduced continuous residuals; paired with a hybrid Transformer that performs autoregressive inference in the discrete domain, with continuous residuals recovered via non-autoregressive prediction and upsampling
summary_en.experiments: Experiments show the framework significantly improves speaker characteristic retention compared to discrete-only methods, while reducing the number of required autoregressive steps
summary_en.authors_note: Work from the team including Mirco Ravanelli, core author of the open-source speech framework SpeechBrain

recommendation.zh: 语音LM tokenizer的实用改进，混合离散连续的思路可迁移到多模态统一预训练的其他模态表示设计，看§3的codec结构即可
recommendation.en: A practical improvement for speech LM tokenizers; the hybrid discrete-continuous idea can be migrated to other modality representation design in unified multimodal pretraining, just read the codec structure in §3

paper.title: Ask, Solve, Generate: Self-Evolving Unified Multimodal Understanding and Generation via Self-Consistency Rewards
paper.abstract: Most unified large multimodal models (LMMs) that support both visual understanding and image generation still rely on curated post-training supervision, such as human annotations, preference labels, or external reward models. We ask whether a unified LMM can improve both abilities autonomously using only unlabeled images. We propose a self-evolving training framework with three internal roles: a Proposer that generates visual questions, a Solver that answers and evaluates them, and a Generator t

summary.core_problem: 现有支持“理解+生成”的统一多模态模型后训练高度依赖人工标注数据，已有的无监督自进化方法存在两个核心缺陷：一是样本级自洽奖励容易退化为低熵的无信息一致信号，导致训练不稳定；二是理解与生成任务优化目标脱节，理解能力提升无法有效传导到生成质量，且现有方法通常仅在单一生成范式上验证，通用性不足。
summary.importance: 该工作验证了完全使用无标注图像同时提升多模态理解与生成能力的可行性，提出的token级不确定性奖励、理解模型介导的生成评估方案，为跨任务自监督优化提供了可迁移的思路，对混合AR+扩散架构的统一多模态模型预训练后持续优化有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 基于冻结的统一多模态主干，训练三个LoRA功能角色：Proposer生成视觉问题，Solver回答问题并作为内部评估器，Generator合成图像。针对奖励退化问题，提出Solver Token Entropy（STE）指标，用token级预测不确定性作为连续的难度度量，解决样本级自洽饱和后无有效训练信号的问题，支撑冷启动阶段的课程学习；针对跨任务耦合弱的问题，用Solver作为生成结果的内置评估器，结合QA保真度（生成图像是否匹配prompt描述属性）、循环一致性（生成图像重打caption与原prompt的匹配度）、多样性三个维度计算生成奖励，让理解能力的提升直接优化生成奖励的质量。整个训练流程不需要人工标注或外部奖励模型，且适配不同生成范式。
summary.experiments: 在三类采用不同生成范式的统一多模态模型上完成验证：扩散架构BLIP3o、整流流架构BAGEL、自回归架构VARGPT-v1.1。同一套训练流程在三个主干上均获得一致提升：理解类百分点指标提升1.9~3.6，MME子项获得双位数提升，GenEval生成指标提升3%，未出现跨任务性能权衡。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可。重点关注方法部分对奖励退化问题的解决方案（STE设计）、跨任务耦合的评估机制，以及跨三类生成范式的通用实验设置，理解同一套流程适配不同架构的核心逻辑，无需关注特定主干的实现细节，预计阅读时间18分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing unified multimodal models supporting both visual understanding and image generation rely heavily on curated annotated data for post-training. Prior unsupervised self-evolution methods suffer from two core limitations: sample-level self-consistency rewards often degenerate into low-entropy, uninformative agreement signals that cause training instability; understanding and generation objectives are poorly coupled, so improvements in understanding do not transfer to generation quality, and existing methods are usually validated on a single generation paradigm with limited generality.
summary_en.importance: This work demonstrates the feasibility of improving both multimodal understanding and generation using only unlabeled images. The proposed token-level uncertainty reward and solver-mediated generation evaluation scheme provides a transferable recipe for cross-task self-supervised optimization, relevant to post-pretraining continual improvement of unified multimodal architectures including hybrid AR+diffusion designs.
summary_en.technical_approach: The framework trains three LoRA-based role adapters on a frozen unified multimodal backbone: a Proposer that generates visual questions, a Solver that answers questions and acts as an internal evaluator, and a Generator that synthesizes images. To address reward degeneracy, Solver Token Entropy (STE) is introduced as a continuous difficulty measure derived from token-level prediction uncertainty, which remains informative even when sample-level consistency saturates, enabling curriculum learning from cold start. To address weak cross-task coupling, the Solver is used as an evaluator for generated images, combining QA fidelity (whether generated images match prompt attributes), cycle consistency (match between re-captioned generated images and original prompts), and diversity to compute generation rewards, so improvements in understanding directly sharpen reward signals for generation. The full pipeline requires no human annotations or external reward models, and is designed to be portable across generation paradigms.
summary_en.experiments: Validated across three unified multimodal backbones spanning fundamentally different generation paradigms: diffusion-based BLIP3o, rectified-flow-based BAGEL, and autoregressive VARGPT-v1.1. The same training recipe delivers consistent gains across all three backbones: 1.9 to 3.6 point improvements on percentage-based understanding metrics, double-digit gains on MME sub-scores, and +3% on the GenEval generation benchmark, with no observed cross-task performance tradeoffs.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim this paper. Prioritize the design of STE for resolving reward degeneracy, the solver-mediated cross-task evaluation mechanism, and the cross-paradigm experimental setup to understand why the recipe works across different generation architectures. Implementation-specific training details for individual backbones can be skipped unless adapting the method to a new model. Expected reading time: 18 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 三角色自博弈+token熵难度调度的设计对统一多模态自训练有参考，重点看§3.2的STE信号定义和§4.3的生成任务评估方案。
recommendation.en: The three-role self-play plus token-entropy difficulty scheduling design is informative for unified multimodal self-training; focus on §3.2 for STE definition and §4.3 for generation evaluation scheme.

institutions: Mohamed bin Zayed University of AI

paper.title: ABACUS: Adapting Unified Foundation Model for Bridging Image Count Understanding and Generation
paper.abstract: ABACUS is a unified vision-language model that handles object counting, crowd counting, referring-expression counting, and count-faithful image generation without any benchmark-specific training required. Our model is built on existing 3B-parameter unified foundation model and is adapted for object localization tasks using three key innovations: density-aware adaptive zooming with objectness maps for spatial grounding; a boundary-aware count policy via GRPO to eliminate crop-boundary errors; and

summary.core_problem: 解决统一视觉语言模型在图像计数理解和计数一致图像生成之间能力不一致的问题，尤其是物体计数、密集人群计数、指代表达计数和生成图像中数量不守恒。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态后训练和统一理解-生成适配。它不是基座预训练工作，但把 GRPO 用在视觉计数策略和生成自校验上，对理解 VLM 的 RL 信号设计有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: ABACUS 基于已有 3B 参数统一基础模型进行适配，不针对单个 benchmark 训练。方法包含三点：用 objectness map 做 density-aware adaptive zooming，提高空间 grounding；用 boundary-aware count policy 结合 GRPO 减少裁剪边界带来的漏数/重复数；用 cycle-consistent GRPO，让理解分支自我评估生成结果，从而不依赖外部标注来约束生成数量。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在七个计数相关 benchmark 上取得领先结果，超过任务专用模型和更大的通用模型；但未提供具体模型底座名称、训练数据规模、GRPO 设置、各 benchmark 数值和提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: ABACUS targets the gap between count understanding and count-faithful image generation in unified vision-language models, covering object counting, crowd counting, referring-expression counting, and generation with correct object counts.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a multimodal adaptation and post-training recipe rather than base pretraining. Its useful signal is how GRPO can be shaped around visual counting policies and self-critique between understanding and generation branches.
summary_en.technical_approach: The model adapts an existing 3B unified foundation model without benchmark-specific training. It uses density-aware adaptive zooming with objectness maps for grounding, a boundary-aware count policy optimized with GRPO to reduce crop-boundary errors, and cycle-consistent GRPO where the understanding branch critiques generated outputs without external annotations.
