summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports leading results on seven counting benchmarks, outperforming task-specific specialists and larger generalist models. It does not provide the exact backbone, training data scale, GRPO details, or per-benchmark effect sizes.

recommendation.zh: 只看 GRPO 计数策略和自循环校验设计；这是 VLM 后训练信号工程，不会改变预训练 prior。
recommendation.en: Skim only the GRPO count-policy and cycle-critique design; it is useful signal engineering for VLM post-training, not a pretraining prior shift.

paper.title: Geometry-Instructed Video Editing
paper.abstract: Object-level geometric edits, including translating, rotating, scaling, duplicating, or removing an object, are routine operations in digital content creation (DCC) workflows, yet they remain unreliable in generative video editing. The key challenge lies in specifying the target object's 3D state change unambiguously across viewpoint and time, while consistently updating geometry-dependent secondary effects such as shadows and reflections. We introduce GIVE, a geometry-instructed video editing f

summary.core_problem: 解决生成式视频编辑中物体级几何操作难以精确指定、跨时间和视角不稳定、且阴影反射等几何相关效应难以同步更新的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是视频生成/编辑中的条件表示和合成监督数据管线。它对统一多模态预训练不是核心工作，但对几何条件如何进入视频生成模型有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 GIVE，用统一 object-state formulation 表示平移、旋转、缩放、复制和删除等操作；使用两个 video-aligned geometry streams：depth-box 编码编辑前后 3D 位置和范围，orientation-box 提供与外观无关的朝向线索；通过 graphics-engine pipeline 构造 paired supervision。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明构建了可扩展图形引擎数据管线用于成对监督，但未给出模型规模、数据量、baseline、指标或具体提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles object-level geometric video editing, where translation, rotation, scaling, duplication, and removal are hard to specify precisely and often fail to update shadows, reflections, and temporal geometry consistently.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a conditioning representation and synthetic paired-supervision pipeline for video generation/editing. It is not central to unified multimodal pretraining, but it is useful background for geometry-conditioned video models.
summary_en.technical_approach: GIVE represents edits with a unified object-state formulation. Two video-aligned geometry streams specify pre- and post-edit states: a depth-box for coarse 3D placement and extent, and an orientation-box for appearance-agnostic orientation. A graphics-engine pipeline supplies paired supervision.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract mentions a scalable graphics-engine pipeline for paired training data, but does not provide model scale, dataset size, baselines, metrics, or numerical gains.

recommendation.zh: 看几何条件表示和数据管线即可；它是视频编辑工程，不是统一建模范式变化。
recommendation.en: Read only the geometry-conditioning design and data pipeline; this is video-editing engineering, not a shift in unified modeling.

paper.title: Atomistic Language Models Understand and Generate Materials
paper.abstract: Atomistic structure and natural language have long been modeled separately, with language models either calling atomistic models as tools or being fine-tuned on lossy textual encodings that discard atomistic information. We introduce Atomistic Language Models (ALMs) to pursue native multimodality, in which a single language backbone understands atomistic structures, generates materials from natural language, and optimizes crystal structures as instructed by text. By unifying a pretrained atomist

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是材料科学中“结构表示”和“自然语言”长期分离的问题：语言模型可以读文本，但不懂原子坐标、晶胞和周期边界；原子模型懂几何结构，但不能用自然语言进行开放式指令交互和生成。作者希望用一个统一模型同时完成结构理解、文本条件生成、文本指令下的晶体优化。
summary.importance: 对 LLM 预训练研究的启发主要在统一建模范式，而不是材料应用本身。它没有把晶体强行序列化成 CIF、Wyckoff string 或其他文本 token，而是保留原子结构的连续几何表示，再通过连续 projector 接入语言模型。这一点对多模态 LM 很有参考价值：有些模态不适合离散化成文本，强行 tokenization 会损失决定性信息；更合理的做法是让专门 encoder 保留模态归纳偏置，再把表示空间接到 LM。论文同时把 causal LM 和 denoising diffusion decoder 组合起来，用 LM latent steering 结构生成，这和 AR+diffusion 统一建模方向有直接关系。
summary.technical_approach: 模型由三类预训练组件组成：OrbV3 作为 atomistic encoder，编码原子、坐标、晶胞等结构信息；Qwen3-8B 作为中心语言骨干；MatterGen 类 denoising diffusion model 作为晶体结构 decoder。三者之间不用离散文本中介，而是用连续 cross-modal projector 连接。训练分三阶段：第一阶段做模态对齐，让结构表示和语言表示进入共享空间；第二阶段做 multi-pattern instruction tuning，使模型能围绕结构、性质、用途和文本指令进行推理；第三阶段做 guided generation，从语言模型中抽取 embedding 来引导 diffusion denoising trajectory。作者拆出三个版本：ALM Core 负责结构理解和属性/应用表征；ALM Edit 在 Core 基础上训练，用较强 steering 控制 diffusion decoder，执行文本指令下的结构优化；ALM Gen 换成弱 steering 的 diffusion model，用于从文本生成无机晶体。为了缓解生成稳定性和文本约束跟随之间的冲突，作者还提出 Text-to-Crystal Feynman–Kac inference-time steering，用于提高 ALM Gen 对化学计量目标的遵循能力。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖结构理解、晶体结构预测、文本指令优化和无机晶体生成。文中明确给出的规模信息包括：语言骨干为 Qwen3-8B，ALM Bench 包含超过 7000 个自然语言—无机晶体指令对。结果层面，ALM Core 在多个材料性质预测任务上达到或超过已有语言模型方法，并接近专门微调的 machine-learning interatomic potential；ALM Edit 在 MP-20 和 MPTS-52 晶体结构预测上取得领先结果，并在 ALM Bench 上超过多个前沿语言模型基线；ALM Gen 在 de novo generation 中表现有竞争力，稳定性通过 MP-20 或 LeMat-GenBench hull 评估。给出的全文片段没有展开具体指标数值、误差、有效率或消融表，因此更适合关注方法结构和训练流程，而不是逐项比较数字。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20–30 分钟。优先看 Figure 2 和 Methods 的模型连接方式，重点理解连续 projector 如何连接 atomistic encoder、LLM 和 diffusion decoder。其次看三阶段训练流程，以及 ALM Core / Edit / Gen 为什么要拆开：Core 偏理解，Edit 偏指令优化，Gen 偏从零生成。T2C-FK 值得单独看，它体现了 inference-time steering 如何修正 diffusion 生成对文本约束的跟随。实验部分可重点扫 ALM Bench 构造、MP-20/MPTS-52 结果和 de novo generation 评估协议。对 LLM 研究员来说，最值得带走的是：复杂连续模态不一定要先离散 token 化，连续 latent bridge 加 LM steering diffusion 是一条可迁移的统一建模路线。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets the separation between atomistic structure modeling and natural-language modeling in materials science. Language models can process textual descriptions but do not natively understand atomic coordinates, unit cells, or periodic boundary conditions. Atomistic models preserve geometry but do not support open-ended instruction following or text-conditioned generation. The goal is a single model that can understand structures, generate materials from text, and optimize crystals under natural-language instructions.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to foundation-model pretraining lies in the modeling pattern rather than the materials domain. The paper avoids converting crystals into lossy textual formats such as CIF strings or Wyckoff strings. Instead, it keeps atomistic information in a continuous geometric representation and connects it to a language backbone through learned continuous projectors. This is a useful design point for multimodal LMs: some modalities should retain their native inductive biases instead of being forced into text-like token sequences. The work also combines a causal LM with a denoising diffusion decoder, making it relevant to unified AR-plus-diffusion modeling.
summary_en.technical_approach: The system combines three pretrained components: OrbV3 as the atomistic encoder, Qwen3-8B as the central language backbone, and a MatterGen-style denoising diffusion model as the crystal-structure decoder. The components communicate through continuous cross-modal projectors rather than discrete text interfaces. Training has three stages: modality alignment, multi-pattern instruction tuning for structure-aware reasoning, and guided generation where embeddings extracted from the LM steer the diffusion denoising process. The authors instantiate three variants. ALM Core focuses on structure understanding and property/application characterization. ALM Edit is fine-tuned from Core and uses stronger steering to optimize crystal structures according to text instructions. ALM Gen uses a weakly steered diffusion generator for de novo inorganic crystal generation. To improve stoichiometric control at inference time, the paper introduces Text-to-Crystal Feynman–Kac steering.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers structure understanding, crystal structure prediction, instruction-conditioned editing, and de novo generation. The visible scale details include a Qwen3-8B language backbone and ALM Bench, which contains more than 7,000 natural-language and inorganic-crystal instruction pairs. ALM Core matches or exceeds prior language-model approaches on measured property prediction tasks and approaches the performance of fine-tuned machine-learning interatomic potentials. ALM Edit reports leading results on MP-20 and MPTS-52 crystal structure prediction and outperforms frontier LM baselines on ALM Bench. ALM Gen is reported to be competitive for de novo generation, with stability assessed using MP-20 or LeMat-GenBench hulls. The provided text does not expose the exact metric values or ablation tables, so the main value is in the architecture and training recipe rather than the numeric comparisons.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Start with Figure 2 and the Methods section to understand how the continuous projectors connect the atomistic encoder, the LM, and the diffusion decoder. Then read the staged training description and the distinction among ALM Core, ALM Edit, and ALM Gen. T2C-FK is worth a focused pass because it shows how inference-time steering can improve constraint following in diffusion-based generation. In the experiments, focus on ALM Bench, MP-20/MPTS-52, and the de novo generation protocol. The transferable idea is that a continuous latent bridge can preserve structured modality information while still allowing an LM to steer generation.

recommendation.zh: 连续投影+扩散引导空间桥接的设计对多模态统一预训练有参考价值，重点读§3的连续桥和T2C-FK采样器两节。
recommendation.en: The continuous projector + diffusion steering-space bridging design is informative for unified multimodal pretraining; focus on §3 for the continuous bridge and T2C-FK sampler.

paper.title: Bagpiper-TTS: Natural Language Guided Universal Speech Synthesis
paper.abstract: Classical TTS systems typically rely on rigid input formats and predefined metadata slots, limiting their ability to fulfill flexible user requirements. This paper introduces Bagpiper-TTS, a universal speech synthesis system that deals with diverse natural language user requests. Given a natural language prompt, Bagpiper-TTS first reasons over the users' intent to derive a rich caption, i.e., a comprehensive textual blueprint encompassing both transcription and nuanced metadata. Subsequently, th

summary.core_problem: 让 TTS 系统从刚性的文本和元数据槽位，转向能理解自然语言用户请求的通用语音合成接口。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态生成系统创新。它更接近语音生成应用系统，而不是语音 LM tokenizer 或统一预训练范式；但“自然语言意图到语音控制蓝图”的两阶段设计，对统一音频生成接口有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: Bagpiper-TTS 先对用户自然语言 prompt 做意图推理，生成 rich caption，作为包含转写文本和细粒度元数据的文本蓝图；随后用该 caption 指导目标语音合成。该设计把多说话人、intent-to-speech、角色扮演、歌声合成等任务统一为自然语言请求到语音的条件生成问题。
summary.experiments: 摘要报告在 Seed-TTS-Eval 上达到 1.7% WER，并在 LLM-as-a-judge 和人工主观评测中，在多个应用上匹配专用模型表现。摘要未给出模型参数量、训练数据规模、声学 tokenizer 或具体 baseline 清单。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Carnegie Mellon University、LY Corporation 和 NVIDIA Research；Shinji Watanabe 是语音与 spoken language processing 领域知名研究者，Chao-Han Huck Yang 长期从事语音和音频生成相关工作。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper aims to move TTS from rigid text-plus-metadata inputs to a universal speech synthesis interface driven by natural-language user requests.
summary_en.importance: This is a multimodal generation system contribution. It is closer to a speech synthesis application than to speech-LM tokenization or unified pretraining, but the natural-language-to-speech-blueprint interface is useful for thinking about controllable audio generation.
summary_en.technical_approach: Bagpiper-TTS first reasons over a natural-language prompt and produces a rich caption that contains both the transcription and detailed metadata. The caption then conditions speech synthesis. This turns multi-speaker synthesis, intent-to-speech, role-play synthesis, singing voice synthesis, and related tasks into one natural-language-conditioned generation setup.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports 1.7% WER on Seed-TTS-Eval and performance comparable to dedicated models under both LLM-as-a-judge and human subjective evaluation across several applications. Model size, training data scale, acoustic tokenization details, and complete baselines are not provided in the abstract.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Carnegie Mellon University, LY Corporation, and NVIDIA Research. Shinji Watanabe is a well-known speech and spoken language processing researcher, and Chao-Han Huck Yang has worked extensively on speech and audio generation.

recommendation.zh: 看 caption-as-control 的接口设计即可；它不是语音基座预训练论文，tokenizer 和训练目标信息不足。
recommendation.en: Skim the caption-as-control interface; this is not a speech foundation pretraining paper, and tokenizer/objective details are thin.

institutions: Language Technologies Institute, Carnegie Mellon University

paper.title: Integrating Facial Generation into Full-Duplex Spoken Dialogue Systems
paper.abstract: Full-duplex spoken dialogue models, such as Moshi, enable natural, low-latency voice conversations. However, they remain limited to the audio modality, lacking the facial expressions that are integral to human communication. We present Moshi-Face, the first full-duplex dialogue model that jointly processes the user's audio and facial input while simultaneously generating speech and facial motion. We first construct a vector-quantized variational autoencoder (VQ-VAE) as a face codec that encodes

summary.core_problem: 现有全双工口语对话模型仅支持音频模态，缺少人脸表情输出，无法实现类人的音视频自然交互。
summary.importance: 首个支持音视频联合输入输出的全双工对话模型Moshi-Face，实现低延迟的语音与人脸动作同步生成，属于多模态生成系统的工程创新。
summary.technical_approach: 1）训练VQ-VAE作为人脸codec，将人脸视频提取的3D头部网格编码为离散人脸token，支持从token重构网格；2）在Moshi语音模型基础上新增Face Transformer模块，非自回归生成人脸token，与语音token实时同步。
summary.experiments: 基于开源Moshi模型扩展，实验显示系统可在保留原有音频对话质量的前提下，实现低延迟音视频对齐，人脸动作与语音同步自然。
summary.authors_note: 名古屋大学信息学研究科团队，基于Kyutai开源的Moshi全双工语音对话模型扩展人脸模态。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing full-duplex spoken dialogue models only support audio modality, lacking facial expression output for natural human-like audiovisual interaction.
summary_en.importance: Proposes Moshi-Face, the first full-duplex dialogue model supporting joint audiovisual input and output, achieving low-latency synchronized generation of speech and facial motion as an engineering innovation in multimodal generation systems.
summary_en.technical_approach: 1) Trains a VQ-VAE face codec to encode 3D head meshes extracted from facial videos into compact discrete face tokens, with mesh reconstruction support; 2) Extends the Moshi audio model with a Face Transformer module that generates face tokens non-autoregressively for real-time synchronization with speech tokens.
summary_en.experiments: Built on the open-source Moshi model, experiments show the system achieves low-latency audiovisual alignment while preserving the dialogue quality of the original audio-only model, with natural synchronization between facial motion and speech.
summary_en.authors_note: Team from Graduate School of Informatics, Nagoya University, extending Kyutai's open-source Moshi full-duplex spoken dialogue model with facial modality.

recommendation.zh: Moshi的人脸模态扩展工程，新模态离散token集成思路可备查，无需读正文。
recommendation.en: Engineering extension of Moshi with face tokens, useful as reference for cross-modal discrete token integration, no need to read full text.

institutions: Graduate School of Informatics, Nagoya University

paper.title: Training-Free Semantic Correction for Autoregressive Visual Models
paper.abstract: Autoregressive visual models (AVMs) based on next-scale prediction have emerged as a prominent paradigm for image and video synthesis. However, decomposing the generation process into discrete scales with varying granularities in AVM makes semantic errors difficult to identify and correct, thereby undermining the quality of the final output. Prior efforts to enhance AVM can be categorized into training-based and training-free approaches. Although training-based efforts to enhance AVM generation

summary.core_problem: 自回归视觉生成模型按尺度逐步生成，早期或中间尺度的语义错误难以及时发现，最后会累积成明显的图像或视频质量问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态生成的采样期改进：不用重新训练 AVM，而是在生成过程中引入 MLLM 反馈做语义纠错。它对统一自回归视觉建模有间接参考价值，但不是预训练方法论文。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Gazer，把多模态大模型接入 autoregressive visual model 的 sampling loop。框架包含 Reflective Diagnosis 和后续纠错阶段：前者检查中间生成状态中的语义偏差，后者在继续采样前对错误进行调整。核心是 training-free、in-generation semantic correction，而不是修改 tokenizer、训练目标或模型架构。
summary.experiments: 摘要未列出具体模型规模、数据集、baseline 名称或数值结果；只说明目标是相对已有 training-free 方法更早诊断中间状态错误，避免错误累积。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Zhejiang University 和 Shandong University。

summary_en.core_problem: Autoregressive visual models generate across discrete scales, making semantic errors at intermediate scales hard to detect before they propagate into the final image or video.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a sampling-time improvement for multimodal generation: it injects MLLM feedback into the generation loop without retraining the AVM. It is indirectly relevant to unified autoregressive visual modeling, but it is not a pretraining-method paper.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes Gazer, which integrates a multimodal LLM into the AVM sampling loop. It uses a reflective diagnosis stage to inspect intermediate generation states and a correction stage to adjust semantic errors before sampling continues. The core idea is training-free in-generation semantic correction, not a change to tokenization, objectives, or architecture.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model sizes, datasets, baseline names, or numerical gains. It claims that monitoring intermediate states can diagnose semantic errors earlier than prior training-free methods and reduce error accumulation.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Zhejiang University and Shandong University.

recommendation.zh: 把 MLLM 当采样期 critic 的思路值得知道，但只看方法图即可；它不回答视觉 token 预训练的核心问题。
recommendation.en: Worth noting as an MLLM-as-sampling-critic pattern; the method figure is enough, since it does not address visual-token pretraining.

paper.title: OmniDrive: An LLM-Choreographed Multi-Agent World Model with Unified Latent Co-Compression for Multi-View Driving Video Generation
paper.abstract: Generative world models for autonomous driving face two unresolved tensions: heterogeneous control injection, where free-form language, HD-maps, trajectories, and camera poses reside in incompatible representational spaces, and post-hoc cross-view fusion, where per-camera latents fail to encode global 3-D geometry. We trace both to a single root cause: the absence of a shared symbolic interlingua aligning language, geometry, and pixels at the latent-token level. We present DRIVE-CHOREO, an LLM-c

summary.core_problem: 解决自动驾驶多视角视频生成中语言、地图、轨迹、相机位姿等控制信号异构，以及多相机 latent 后融合缺乏全局 3D 一致性的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态生成和世界模型系统创新。它把 VLM/LLM agent、结构化中间表示和多视角视频 latent co-compression 结合起来，和统一 token 表示、跨模态控制注入有一定关系，但场景仍是驾驶视频生成。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 DRIVE-CHOREO，将可控多视角视频生成重写为 latent choreography。系统使用三个 Qwen2.5-VL agent：Director 将用户意图解析为结构化 WorldScript，Cartographer 将其落到空间锚定 layout tokens，Auditor 用跨视角 critique 作为辅助监督。最终生成单一位置感知 token 序列，并通过 view-time permutation 与多视角视频共同压缩，以促使控制、几何和像素在 latent-token 层面对齐。
summary.experiments: 摘要未提供模型参数、训练数据规模、对比方法或定量提升。可确认的是方法面向 multi-view driving video generation，强调语言、HD map、轨迹、相机姿态等控制信号和多视角视频 latent 的联合建模。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses controllable multi-view driving video generation, where heterogeneous controls and post-hoc cross-view fusion fail to provide a shared 3D-consistent latent structure.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a multimodal generative world-model system. It is relevant to unified token representations and control injection, but the evidence is still from an autonomous-driving generation setting.
summary_en.technical_approach: DRIVE-CHOREO recasts multi-view video generation as latent choreography. Three Qwen2.5-VL agents act as a Director, Cartographer, and Auditor: they parse user intent into WorldScript, ground it into spatial layout tokens, and provide cross-view critiques as auxiliary supervision. The resulting position-aware token sequence is co-compressed with multi-view video through a view-time permutation.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model sizes, data scale, baselines, or quantitative gains. The described setup targets language-, map-, trajectory-, and camera-pose-controlled multi-view driving video generation.

recommendation.zh: 可看 latent-token 对齐和 view-time co-compression 设计；agent 编排像系统胶水，别把驾驶结果外推到通用世界模型。
recommendation.en: Skim the latent-token alignment and view-time co-compression design; the agent choreography is mostly system glue and should not be over-generalized.

paper.title: MUNI: Multimodal Unified Latent Diffusion for Coherent Any-to-Any Generation
paper.abstract: We introduce MUNI, an end-to-end multimodal latent diffusion framework for any-to-any generation that unifies subset-conditioned cross-modal generation and unconditional joint sampling through a shared stochastic latent. Existing multimodal generative models are largely LLM-based, which limits leveraging modality-specific generators and requires text-paired data for training. Recent diffusion- and flow-based any-to-any extensions take a different direction but still rely on text-aligned embeddin

summary.core_problem: 现有任意模态到任意模态生成框架要么依赖LLM与文本配对数据，要么需要全配对训练、对齐嵌入或确定性维度匹配，难以端到端统一条件生成与无条件联合采样。
summary.importance: 范式创新，提出共享随机潜空间的多模态潜扩散统一框架，绕开文本对齐与全配对数据约束，为any-to-any生成提供新的端到端训练路径。
summary.technical_approach: 提出MUNI：1）架构上联合训练各模态编码器、解码器与单一共享flow-based先验，替代传统两阶段冻结潜空间+拟合先验的流程；2）训练目标上通过共享随机潜变量统一子集条件跨模态生成与无条件联合采样。
summary.experiments: 论文摘要未披露具体模型规模、训练数据集大小与定量对比结果，仅给出框架设计与核心动机。
summary.authors_note: Cohere团队，Minhyuk Sung为通讯作者，团队长期从事3D与多模态生成研究。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing any-to-any multimodal generation frameworks either rely on LLMs with text-paired data or require fully-paired training, aligned embeddings, or deterministic dimension matching, failing to unify conditional cross-modal generation and unconditional joint sampling end-to-end.
summary_en.importance: Paradigm innovation: proposes a unified multimodal latent diffusion framework with a shared stochastic latent, bypassing text alignment and fully paired data constraints to enable end-to-end any-to-any generation.
summary_en.technical_approach: MUNI introduces two core designs: 1) architecturally, it jointly trains modality-specific encoders, decoders, and a single shared flow-based prior under one objective, replacing the standard two-stage frozen latent + prior fitting recipe; 2) the training objective unifies subset-conditioned cross-modal generation and unconditional joint sampling via the shared stochastic latent.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not disclose specific model scales, training dataset sizes, or quantitative benchmark results; only framework design and core motivations are presented.
summary_en.authors_note: Cohere team, with Minhyuk Sung as corresponding author; the group has long worked on 3D and multimodal generation.

recommendation.zh: 共享潜空间+联合训练先验的思路对统一多模态预训练有参考，重点看§3的目标函数设计与模态接口定义。
recommendation.en: The shared latent space + jointly trained prior design offers useful references for unified multimodal pretraining; focus on §3 objective formulation and modality interface definitions.

paper.title: SACE: Concept Erasure at the Semantic Singularity in Visual Autoregressive Models
paper.abstract: The rapid progress of visual autoregressive (VAR) models has unlocked a transformative frontier for high-fidelity text-to-image synthesis, while heightening concerns over the safety alignment of generated content. Naive application of existing erasure techniques to VAR models causes catastrophic semantic collapse and visual artifacts, since they are predominantly designed for the homogeneous denoising steps of diffusion models. To address this foundational challenge, we first propose the Semanti

summary.core_problem: 视觉自回归（VAR）模型的安全对齐：现有concept erasure方法因设计用于扩散模型的均匀去噪步骤，直接应用于VAR导致灾难性语义崩溃和视觉伪影。
summary.importance: 方法创新：提出Semantic Singularity Axiom，首次为VAR模型设计scale-aware概念擦除框架SACE。
summary.technical_approach: 提出增量语义显著性分析（ISSA）验证Semantic Singularity Axiom（目标语义概念在Scale-0锁定），SACE严格将干预限制在first scale实现概念擦除。
summary.experiments: 在VAR模型上验证，对比现有erasure方法在语义保持和概念擦除效果上的优势，无大规模定量对比。

summary_en.core_problem: Safety alignment of visual autoregressive (VAR) models: existing concept erasure methods designed for diffusion's homogeneous denoising steps cause catastrophic semantic collapse when applied to VAR.
summary_en.importance: Method innovation: proposes Semantic Singularity Axiom and first scale-aware concept erasure framework (SACE) for VAR models.
summary_en.technical_approach: Incremental Semantic Saliency Analysis (ISSA) validates that target semantic concepts are locked at Scale-0; SACE confines interventions strictly to the first scale for concept erasure.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on VAR models; compares favorably against existing erasure methods on semantic preservation and erasure efficacy.

recommendation.zh: 多模态生成安全对齐工作，Semantic Singularity Axiom有一定独创性，但对LLM pretrain研究员非核心，看摘要了解思路即可。
recommendation.en: Multimodal generation safety alignment; Semantic Singularity Axiom is somewhat original but peripheral to LLM pretraining. Glance for conceptual interest only.

paper.title: Pixel-TTS: Image based Text Rendering for Robust Text-to-Speech
paper.abstract: Recent advances in pixel-based text modeling show that representing text as images enables models to exploit visual cues for language understanding. Grounding text in its visual form allows structurally similar characters with different Unicode encodings to produce similar embeddings, benefiting cross-lingual and zero-shot scenarios. Conventional text-based approaches treat each character independently, limiting generalization to unseen characters and requiring embedding expansion during cross-l

summary.core_problem: 传统字符级 TTS 依赖独立字符嵌入，在跨语言、未见字符与字形变体场景下泛化差，且跨语言微调需扩展嵌入矩阵。
summary.importance: 方法创新：首次提出视觉接地的 TTS 框架，将文本渲染为图像作为输入，为低资源/跨语言语音合成提供了不依赖 Unicode 字符表的新路径。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Pixel-TTS：先把输入文本渲染为像素图像，再通过 2D 卷积层投影得到序列嵌入，替代传统字符嵌入层；后续接标准 TTS 声学/声码器模块。
summary.experiments: 在多语言 TTS 基准上与强基线对比，取得可比的合成质量；训练收敛更快，在未见字符与零样本跨语言场景下表现更鲁棒。

summary_en.core_problem: Conventional character-level TTS uses independent character embeddings, limiting generalization to unseen characters, orthographic variants, and cross-lingual transfer while requiring embedding matrix expansion during fine-tuning.
summary_en.importance: Methodological novelty: the first visually-grounded TTS framework that takes rendered text images as input, offering a Unicode-vocabulary-agnostic path for low-resource and cross-lingual speech synthesis.
summary_en.technical_approach: Pixel-TTS renders input text into pixel images and projects them into sequence embeddings via a 2D convolutional layer, replacing the standard character embedding table before the acoustic and vocoder stages.
summary_en.experiments: Achieves competitive speech quality against strong baselines on multilingual TTS benchmarks, with faster convergence and improved robustness on unseen characters and zero-shot cross-lingual settings.

recommendation.zh: 用图像替代字符嵌入的思路对统一多模态 tokenizer 有弱启发，TTS 领域外价值有限，扫一眼方法图即可。
recommendation.en: Replacing character embeddings with rendered images gives weak hints for unified multimodal tokenizers; limited value outside TTS, skim the method figure only.

paper.title: Helping Figures Tell their Story! Paper-Grounded Video Generation Explaining Complex Scientific Figures
paper.abstract: Scientific figures compress complex pipelines into a single canvas, yet understanding them requires paper-grounded, step-by-step narration aligned with visual highlights a capability missing from current video generation systems and benchmarks. To address this, we introduce paper-grounded figure-to-video generation: generating narrated, region-grounded walkthrough videos from a figure and its paper. We propose MINARD (Multimodal Interpretation of Narrated Architecture via Region Decomposition),

summary.core_problem: 让模型基于论文正文和科学图表，生成带旁白、按区域高亮的解释视频。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态生成任务定义、方法管线和评测资源。它把科学图表理解、文档 grounding、区域级视觉指代和视频化讲解放在同一任务里，对 VLM/多模态生成评测有一定参考，但不是基座预训练方法论文。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 MINARD 管线：先从论文和图表生成忠实于论文内容的分步旁白，再把旁白片段顺序对齐到图中区域，形成可视化 walkthrough。论文还发布 FigTalk benchmark，并设计顺序 grounding 和组件级 grounding 指标，用于衡量解释是否对应正确图表区域。
summary.experiments: 在 FigTalk 上比较 MINARD 与已有方法。摘要称 MINARD 在自动指标和人工评估中生成更接近人类、对论文更忠实的旁白，并在 narration-conditioned figure spatial grounding 上优于现有方法；未在摘要中给出模型参数量、训练数据规模或具体提升数字。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 University of Maryland, College Park；Jordan Boyd-Graber 长期从事 NLP、问答、信息检索和人机评测相关研究。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how to generate narrated, region-grounded explanatory videos for scientific figures using both the figure and the paper text.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a new multimodal generation task, a pipeline, and an evaluation asset. It combines scientific figure understanding, document grounding, visual region reference, and video-style explanation. It is relevant to VLM evaluation and multimodal generation, but it is not a foundation-model pretraining paper.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors propose MINARD, a pipeline that first generates paper-faithful step-by-step narrations and then sequentially grounds each narration segment to figure regions. They also release FigTalk with sequential and component-level grounding metrics to test whether the generated explanation points to the right parts of the figure.
summary_en.experiments: On FigTalk, MINARD is compared against existing approaches. The abstract reports more humanlike and paper-faithful narrations and better narration-conditioned figure spatial grounding under both automatic and human evaluation, but does not provide parameter scale, training data size, or exact gains.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from the University of Maryland, College Park. Jordan Boyd-Graber is known for work in NLP, question answering, information retrieval, and human-centered evaluation.

recommendation.zh: 只看任务定义和 grounding 指标即可；它对科学 VLM eval 有用，但不改变多模态预训练的建模选择。
recommendation.en: Skim the task definition and grounding metrics; useful for scientific VLM eval, but it does not change multimodal pretraining design choices.

paper.title: Modality Forcing for Scalable Spatial Generation
paper.abstract: Text-to-image (T2I) models contain rich spatial priors. Synthesizing photorealistic, cluttered scenes requires an understanding of geometry, including perspective and relative scale. Prior works adapt T2I models to leverage this prior for depth prediction, but they require dense depth data and involve complex recipes. We propose Modality Forcing, a simple, scalable post-training recipe for joint image-depth generation using a single DiT trained on sparse depth data. Modality Forcing enables cond

summary.core_problem: 如何利用文本到图像（T2I）模型的空间先验，通过简单的后训练配方实现可扩展的图像和深度联合生成？
summary.importance: 提出Modality Forcing，一种简单且可扩展的后训练方法，仅需稀疏深度数据即可在单个DiT上实现图像和深度的联合生成，避免了以往方法对密集深度数据的依赖和复杂的训练流程。
summary.technical_approach: 通过为每种模态分配独立的噪声水平（Modality Forcing），实现图像和深度在任意排列下的条件和联合生成。使用每种模态的解码器，允许在稀疏的真实世界深度数据上进行训练。通过从头训练一系列T2I模型（370M到3.3B），验证了该方法继承了T2I预训练的可扩展性。
summary.experiments: 训练了370M到3.3B参数的模型，发现更大的模型在更多图像数据上训练能产生更准确的深度。最强模型在深度预测上具有竞争力。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自CMU、Google DeepMind等，Deva Ramanan和Justin Johnson是计算机视觉领域的知名学者。

summary_en.core_problem: How to leverage the spatial priors of Text-to-Image (T2I) models for scalable joint image and depth generation using a simple post-training recipe?
summary_en.importance: Proposes Modality Forcing, a simple and scalable post-training method enabling joint image and depth generation on a single DiT using only sparse depth data, avoiding the reliance on dense depth data and complex pipelines of prior methods.
summary_en.technical_approach: Enables conditional and joint generation of image and depth in any permutation by assigning separate noise levels per modality (Modality Forcing). Per-modality decoders allow training on sparse, real-world depth data. Validates that the method inherits T2I pre-training scalability by training a suite of T2I models from scratch (370M to 3.3B).
summary_en.experiments: Trained models from 370M to 3.3B parameters, finding larger models trained on more image data produce more accurate depth. The strongest model is competitive in depth prediction.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors are from CMU, Google DeepMind, etc. Deva Ramanan and Justin Johnson are well-known scholars in computer vision.

recommendation.zh: 通过独立噪声调度实现多模态（图像+深度）联合生成的后训练方法，对多模态 Diffusion 建模有一定启发，但偏向 CV 任务。
recommendation.en: A post-training method achieving multimodal (image+depth) joint generation via independent noise scheduling, offering some inspiration for multimodal Diffusion modeling, but leans towards CV tasks.

paper.title: IDEAL: In-DEpth ALignment Makes A Discrete Representation AutoEncoder
paper.abstract: Built on pretrained vision foundation models (VFMs), representation autoencoders (RAEs) have recently emerged as a promising approach for constructing semantically rich latent spaces for image generation. However, their reconstruction quality often remains suboptimal, largely because deep VFM representations do not preserve sufficient fine-grained visual detail. This limitation becomes even more severe after discretization, where missing low-level information is difficult to recover. In fact, we

summary.core_problem: 现有基于预训练视觉基础模型的表示自编码器仅用深层特征，离散化后丢失细粒度视觉细节，重建质量不佳的问题
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出深浅层特征联合对齐的离散自编码框架，同时保留视觉token的语义和保真度
summary.technical_approach: 提出IDEAL框架，将量化后的离散token同时与浅层和深层VFM特征对齐，融合浅层的细粒度结构信息和深层的高层语义信息
summary.experiments: 在图像重建、生成任务上验证，相比现有基于VFM的表示自编码器，在视觉保真度和语义一致性上取得稳定提升
summary.authors_note: 复旦大学计算机学院团队，Yu-Gang Jiang长期从事多模态理解、视频分析领域研究

summary_en.core_problem: Existing representation autoencoders based on pretrained vision foundation models only use deep features, losing fine-grained visual details after discretization and leading to suboptimal reconstruction quality
summary_en.importance: Method innovation, proposes an in-depth alignment framework for discrete autoencoding that preserves both semantics and fidelity of visual tokens
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes IDEAL framework, jointly aligns quantized discrete tokens with both shallow and deep VFM features, fusing fine-grained structural information from shallow layers and high-level semantics from deep layers
summary_en.experiments: Validated on image reconstruction and generation tasks, achieves consistent improvements in visual fidelity and semantic consistency over existing VFM-based representation autoencoders
summary_en.authors_note: Research team from Fudan University, Yu-Gang Jiang has long worked on multimodal understanding and video analysis

recommendation.zh: 视觉离散token化的增量改进工作，仅做多模态预训练tokenizer选型时作为背景文献备查。
recommendation.en: Incremental improvement on discrete visual tokenization, only for background reference when selecting tokenizers for multimodal pretraining.

paper.title: ViMax: Agentic Video Generation
paper.abstract: Long-form video generation requires systematic narrative planning and visual consistency that current short-clip methods cannot provide. Existing methods generate isolated sequences without narrative structure and lack mechanisms for maintaining character and environmental consistency across scenes. We present ViMax, an agentic video generation framework that addresses video creation through coordinated multi-agent collaboration where specialized components negotiate narrative decisions, visual

summary.core_problem: 现有长视频生成方法缺乏叙事结构设计，无法跨场景维持角色与环境一致性。
summary.importance: 范式创新，首次将多智能体协作框架引入长视频生成，解决长时序叙事与一致性难题。
summary.technical_approach: 提出ViMax多智能体长视频生成框架，包含分层叙事引擎实现全局故事连贯性、依赖感知视觉一致性机制跟踪跨时序状态、VLM引导的智能体持续监控优化叙事与视觉质量。
summary.experiments: 未公开具体量化对比指标，验证了框架可生成长时长连贯叙事内容，维持故事与视觉一致性。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自香港大学、新加坡国立大学等机构，研究方向为多模态生成与智能体系统。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing long-form video generation methods lack narrative structure design and cannot maintain character and environmental consistency across scenes.
summary_en.importance: Paradigm innovation, first introduces a multi-agent collaboration framework into long-form video generation to solve long-sequence narrative and consistency challenges.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes ViMax multi-agent long-form video generation framework, including a hierarchical narrative engine for global story coherence, a dependency-aware visual consistency mechanism to track cross-temporal states, and VLM-guided agents to continuously monitor and optimize narrative and visual quality.
summary_en.experiments: No specific quantitative comparison metrics released; verifies the framework can generate long-form coherent narrative content, maintaining story and visual consistency.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors are from The University of Hong Kong, National University of Singapore and other institutions, with research directions in multimodal generation and agent systems.

recommendation.zh: 多智能体长视频生成的概念性框架，暂无严格量化实验，仅作为多模态生成领域的新方向参考，无需深读。
recommendation.en: Conceptual framework for multi-agent long-form video generation, lacking rigorous quantitative experiments; only serves as a reference for new directions in multimodal generation, no in-depth reading required.

paper.title: TIDE: Task-Isolated Diffusion for Unified Video Editing and Generation
paper.abstract: Recent advances in Diffusion Transformers have driven rapid progress in video generation and editing, yet these capabilities are still handled by separate, task-specific models. Building a unified framework that supports diverse video tasks remains an open challenge: existing unified attempts either require dedicated auxiliary encoders or lack explicit mechanisms to distinguish heterogeneous conditioning tokens, struggling when the number and type of visual conditions vary across tasks. We propo

summary.core_problem: 在一个统一视频扩散框架中同时支持指令编辑、参考编辑和多参考生成，并处理不同任务条件 token 的混杂问题。
summary.importance: 这是视频生成/编辑统一建模工作。对纯 LLM 预训练帮助有限，但对跨模态统一建模、条件 token 设计和任务隔离机制有一些可迁移的启发。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 TIDE，在 Diffusion Transformer 中引入 per-token task embeddings，为 target/source/reference token 显式打上任务身份；再用 dual-path conditioning，同时结合视觉语言模型提供的高层语义与细粒度结构条件，以兼顾语义一致性和结构保真。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型参数、训练数据规模和具体提升幅度；实验应覆盖统一视频编辑与生成多任务设定，并与任务专用模型或既有统一框架比较质量和泛化。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper seeks to unify instruction-based editing, reference-guided editing, and multi-reference generation within one video diffusion framework while handling heterogeneous conditioning tokens.
summary_en.importance: This is a video generation/editing paper. Its direct value for LLM pretraining is limited, but it offers some transferable ideas for cross-modal unified modeling, conditional token design, and task isolation.
summary_en.technical_approach: TIDE introduces per-token task embeddings in a Diffusion Transformer so each target/source/reference token carries an explicit task identity. It also uses a dual-path conditioning scheme that combines high-level semantics from a vision-language model with fine-grained structural guidance.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model size, training data scale, or exact gains. The evaluation likely covers unified video editing and generation across multiple tasks against task-specific baselines and prior unified frameworks.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 核心，但“按 token 显式标注任务身份”这个设计值得记一下；若你做 AR+diffusion 统一建模，可只看条件编码部分。
recommendation.en: Not core pretraining work, but the explicit per-token task identity is worth noting; if you work on AR+diffusion unified modeling, just read the conditioning design.

paper.title: Is This Edit Correct? A Multi-Dimensional Benchmark for Reasoning-Aware Image Editing
paper.abstract: Diffusion-based image editing has achieved strong visual fidelity under natural language instructions, yet most existing systems still operate at the level of surface instruction following, without reasoning about the implicit contextual constraints embedded in real user requests. This often leads to visually plausible but logically inconsistent edits. In this work, we introduce RE-Edit, a benchmark for REasoning-aware image Editing that evaluates image editing systems across five complementary

summary.core_problem: 评估图像编辑模型是否真正理解带隐含约束的自然语言编辑请求，而不只是做表面指令跟随。
summary.importance: 核心贡献是 benchmark。它把 reasoning-aware image editing 拆成物理、环境、文化、因果、指代五类约束，提供更细粒度的失败分析框架。对做统一多模态生成或文本-图像对齐的人有间接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 RE-Edit 基准，构造 1000 个需要隐式推理才能正确编辑的样本，并设计与五个推理维度对齐的评测标准；系统评测 10 个开源和 2 个闭源图像编辑模型。
summary.experiments: 数据规模为 1000 条精编样本；比较对象覆盖主流 diffusion-based image editing 系统。结论是即便先进模型也会频繁生成视觉上合理但逻辑上错误的编辑结果。摘要未给出具体分数和领先模型。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates whether image-editing models truly handle implicit reasoning constraints in user instructions rather than merely following surface text.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is a benchmark. By decomposing reasoning-aware image editing into physical, environmental, cultural, causal, and referential dimensions, it offers a more diagnostic evaluation setup. This is only indirectly relevant to unified multimodal generation and alignment research.
summary_en.technical_approach: It introduces RE-Edit, a 1,000-sample benchmark where correct editing requires implicit reasoning, along with dimension-aligned evaluation criteria, and studies 10 open-source plus 2 commercial image-editing models.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark contains 1,000 curated samples; evaluated systems are mainstream diffusion-based image editors. The headline result is that even strong models often produce visually plausible but logically inconsistent edits, though the abstract does not report exact scores.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但如果你在做统一多模态生成，知道‘视觉合理≠语义正确’这类评测缺口有用；读任务定义和错误分类就够了。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but useful if you work on unified multimodal generation: it exposes the gap between visual plausibility and semantic correctness; the task definition and error taxonomy are enough.

paper.title: Edit-R2: Context-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Turn Image Editing
paper.abstract: Text-guided image editing has advanced rapidly with diffusion models and unified multimodal foundation models. However, most existing methods remain confined to single-turn settings, overlooking the more realistic scenario of multi-turn in-context editing, where users iteratively refine an image through a sequence of instructions. In this setting, a model must follow each new instruction while preserving accumulated session-level constraints, challenged by two coupled failure modes: long-context

summary.core_problem: 现有文本引导图像编辑方法多为单轮设计，无法解决多轮编辑场景下的长上下文约束稀释与前期错误累积污染问题
summary.importance: 多模态生成领域的增量方法创新，面向多轮图像编辑场景
summary.technical_approach: 提出Edit-R2强化学习后训练框架，每次编辑前重构会话意图，将分散的历史约束整合为显式推理轨迹，采用上下文感知的RL优化多轮编辑的一致性与指令遵循能力
summary.experiments: 论文摘要被截断，未完整披露实验设置、模型规模与量化效果，仅公开框架设计与问题分析
summary.authors_note: 作者包含商汤科技知名生成模型研究者Xintao Wang

summary_en.core_problem: Existing text-guided image editing methods are mostly designed for single-turn settings, and cannot solve long-context constraint dilution and early error accumulation in multi-turn editing scenarios
summary_en.importance: Incremental methodological innovation in multimodal generation, targeting multi-turn image editing scenarios
summary_en.technical_approach: Propose the Edit-R2 reinforcement learning post-training framework, which reconstructs session intent before each editing turn to consolidate scattered historical constraints into an explicit reasoning trace, and uses context-aware RL to optimize consistency and instruction following across turns
summary_en.experiments: Abstract is truncated; no complete experimental setup, model scale or quantitative results are disclosed, only framework design and problem analysis are presented
summary_en.authors_note: Authored by Xintao Wang, a well-known generative model researcher from SenseTime

recommendation.zh: 多模态生成领域的增量工作，仅聚焦多轮图像编辑场景，对通用多模态基座预训练的直接启发有限，扫一眼摘要即可
recommendation.en: Incremental work in multimodal generation, only focuses on multi-turn image editing; limited direct insight for general multimodal foundation pretraining, just skim the abstract

paper.title: Imagine Before You Predict: Interleaved Latent Visual Reasoning for Video Event Prediction
paper.abstract: Video event prediction (VEP) requires models to infer unobserved future states from partial video evidence. Existing video MLLMs usually verbalize intermediate future reasoning in text space: once visual evidence is verbalized, fine-grained motion, geometry, and interaction cues can be lost, leading to plausible but visually ungrounded hallucinations. We introduce Future-L1, an interleaved latent visual reasoning framework that lets an MLLM alternate between language tokens and continuous latent

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是视频事件预测里一个很具体但也很典型的问题：模型需要根据部分视频去推断未来会发生什么，而现有视频 MLLM 往往把中间推理先翻译成文本。这样做便于自回归生成，却会丢掉运动、几何关系、交互顺序这类未来预测真正依赖的细粒度视觉结构。论文试图给模型一个更合适的中间推理接口：在文本 token 之间插入连续 latent visual span，让模型在生成过程中交替使用语言和潜在视觉状态来“想象未来”。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接关系不如纯语言建模强，但它提供了两个有启发的点。第一，连续 latent 作为中间推理通道，未必只适合静态图像问答，也可以扩展到时间结构更强的视频未来建模。第二，作者把 SFT 冷启动、数据筛选和 latent-aware RL 串成一个闭环，说明这类新推理接口往往不能只靠监督学习学出来，训练信号设计同样关键。对于关心多模态统一建模、latent reasoning、以及 pretrain/post-train 接口的人，这篇更像一个有代表性的系统化 recipe，而不是单点技巧。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是 Future-L1。模型基于标准视频 MLLM 骨干，额外引入一个 latent visual reasoning channel，并定义三个特殊标记：<|latent_start|>、<|latent|>、<|latent_end|>。生成开始于文本模式；一旦模型输出 latent_start，后续每个 latent 位置不再经过词表投影，而是直接把该位置 hidden state 作为连续 latent，并把它反馈为下一步输入 embedding。这样 latent span 内部形成一个连续状态自回归过程，同时这些状态保留在 KV cache 中，供后续文本推理读取。span 长度可变，并允许一次回答中出现多个 latent span，使模型能按需分配“视觉思考”预算。

训练分两阶段。第一阶段是 SFT 冷启动。作者从 TwiFF-2.7M 中构造 Future-L1-50K，不是简单抽样，而是做 visual-gain curation：对每个候选样本，用 Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct 比较“只看观测前缀”与“额外给中间未来帧提示”两种条件下的预测效果，只保留那些未来视觉提示确实带来边际收益的样本。这样筛掉两类无效数据：一类是不需要未来视觉也能答对的简单样本，另一类是即便给未来帧也无帮助的噪声样本。SFT 时，模型既学习何时触发 latent span，也把 latent hidden states 对齐到未来帧 embedding，给 RL 提供可用初始轨迹。

第二阶段是 LA-DAPO，一种 latent-aware RL 目标。它不只奖励最终答案对错，还对采样得到的 latent trajectory 施加 outcome-contrastive 和 temporal-diversity 奖励。前者鼓励那些能导向正确预测的 latent 未来轨迹，后者抑制重复、塌缩的视觉思维过程。这个设计的意图很明确：如果只看最终答案，latent span 很容易退化成可有可无的中间噪声；加入对 latent 轨迹质量和多样性的约束，模型才更可能真正利用连续视觉通道。
summary.experiments: 结果主要集中在两个 benchmark。FutureBench 上，Future-L1-RL 把 Qwen3-VL-8B 从 61.0 提升到 85.4，超过文中对比的前一最好方法 Video-CoE 10.4 分。TwiFF-Bench 上，平均分从 2.44 提升到 3.04。更关键的是训练范式对比：在相同 curated data source 下，text-only SFT 只能到 65.0，而 interleaved latent SFT 达到 73.2，说明收益不只是“多了监督数据”，而是中间推理模态更匹配未来视觉结构。全文主张 RL 进一步把 latent 轨迹从“可用”推到“更稳定、更有效”，但从研究判断上，更值得注意的是数据筛选和 latent interface 本身已经带来明显增益；RL 是在这个接口成立之后继续放大效果。
summary.reading_guide: 这篇适合泛读，重点看三块。先看 Method 里 latent span 的生成机制，理解它和普通文本 CoT、以及一次性视觉 hint 的区别。再看 Future-L1-50K 的 visual-gain curation，这部分决定了作者为什么不用全量 TwiFF，而要按“未来帧是否真的有边际帮助”来筛数据。最后看 SFT 与 LA-DAPO 的对比实验，尤其是 text-only SFT、interleaved latent SFT、以及 RL 之后的差距，能帮助判断性能提升分别来自接口、数据还是优化目标。预计 25 到 35 分钟可以读完主线；如果你关心 latent reasoning 是否真的被模型使用，还应留意文中是否提供了足够强的因果诊断，这一点相较于更偏分析型的工作仍然偏弱。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a specific failure mode in video event prediction. The model must infer unseen future states from a partial video, yet most video MLLMs externalize intermediate reasoning in text. That interface is convenient for autoregressive decoding but poorly matched to future visual dynamics, because motion, geometry, and interaction cues are compressed into language too early. The proposed solution is to let the model reason through interleaved continuous visual latents during generation, so that language can organize the process while latent spans preserve future-oriented visual structure.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to pretraining is indirect but meaningful. The paper shows that continuous latent reasoning channels are not limited to static image QA; they can be extended to temporally structured prediction where the intermediate state should represent evolving future visuals. It also presents a full training recipe rather than a single trick: curated supervision for cold start, a dedicated latent interface, and latent-aware RL for trajectory refinement. For researchers interested in multimodal pretraining, latent reasoning, or the pretrain-to-post-train interface, the useful takeaway is that new reasoning channels often need matched data selection and optimization signals, not just architectural insertion.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The core method is Future-L1. Starting from a standard video MLLM backbone, the model is augmented with a latent visual reasoning channel controlled by three special tokens: <|latent_start|>, <|latent|>, and <|latent_end|>. Generation begins in text mode. Once <|latent_start|> is emitted, each subsequent latent position produces a hidden state that is not projected to the vocabulary; instead, that hidden state is fed back as the next-step input embedding. This creates an autoregressive continuous-state process inside the latent span, and those latent states remain in the KV cache so later text tokens can condition on them. Span length is variable, and multiple latent spans can appear in one response, allowing adaptive allocation of visual reasoning budget.

Training has two stages. The first is supervised cold start. The authors build Future-L1-50K from TwiFF-2.7M using visual-gain curation rather than naive sampling. For each candidate example, they compare a strong base model under two conditions: observed video prefix only, versus prefix plus an intermediate future-frame hint. They keep examples where the future visual hint provides measurable marginal utility. This removes easy cases that do not need future imagination and noisy cases where the hint is not informative. During SFT, the model learns both when to open latent spans and how to align latent hidden states with future-frame embeddings.

The second stage is LA-DAPO, a latent-aware RL objective. It optimizes sampled latent trajectories using outcome-contrastive rewards and temporal-diversity rewards. The first favors latent futures that lead to correct event prediction; the second discourages repetitive or collapsed latent thought patterns. The motivation is clear: if optimization only rewards the final answer, the latent channel may become decorative. By assigning credit to latent trajectory quality, the method tries to make the continuous visual reasoning path genuinely useful.
summary_en.experiments: The main results are reported on two benchmarks. On FutureBench, Future-L1-RL improves Qwen3-VL-8B from 61.0 to 85.4, outperforming the previous best method cited in the paper, Video-CoE, by 10.4 points. On TwiFF-Bench, the average score rises from 2.44 to 3.04. The more informative comparison is within the same curated data source: text-only SFT reaches 65.0, while interleaved-latent SFT reaches 73.2. That gap suggests the gain is not merely due to extra supervision, but to using an intermediate modality better aligned with future visual structure. The paper further argues that RL improves latent trajectory quality beyond SFT. From a research perspective, the strongest evidence is that the latent interface plus data curation already matter substantially, while RL amplifies the effect once the interface is usable.
summary_en.reading_guide: This is a skim paper. Read the method section first to understand how latent spans differ from ordinary text chain-of-thought and from one-shot visual hints. Then inspect the Future-L1-50K curation pipeline, because the data filtering criterion is central to the claimed gains. Finally, compare text-only SFT, interleaved latent SFT, and RL-enhanced results to separate the contributions of interface design, data selection, and optimization. A 25–35 minute pass should be enough for the main story. If your interest is causal use of latent reasoning rather than raw benchmark gains, pay attention to whether the paper provides strong diagnostics for latent reliance; that part appears less developed than the training recipe itself.

recommendation.zh: 多模态推理范式的有价值尝试，混合离散token与连续潜在空间的解码思路对统一建模范式有参考意义，重点看方法部分和LA-DAPO设计。
recommendation.en: A valuable attempt at multimodal reasoning paradigm. The idea of mixing discrete tokens and continuous latent space decoding is referential for unified modeling paradigms; focus on the method section and LA-DAPO design.

paper.title: DREAM-S: Speculative Decoding with Searchable Drafting and Target-Aware Refinement for Multimodal Generation
paper.abstract: Speculative decoding (SD) has proven to be an effective technique for accelerating autoregressive generation in large language models (LLMs) however, its application to vision-language models (VLMs) remains relatively unexplored. We propose~\textit{DREAM-S}, a novel SD framework designed specifically for fast and efficient decoding in VLMs. DREAM-S leverages a neural architecture search (NAS) framework with target-aware supernet training to automatically identify both the optimal interaction str

summary.core_problem: 该工作解决 VLM 自回归生成中的 speculative decoding 适配问题：文本 LLM 上的草稿模型加速方法不能直接迁移到多模态场景，因为视觉 token、文本 token、跨模态交互和目标模型中间表示都会影响草稿 token 的接受率与推理延迟。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练研究的直接影响有限，更偏推理加速与部署效率。但它有一个有用信号：VLM 的解码加速不能只看小草稿模型的语言建模能力，还要考虑视觉输入剪枝、目标模型中间层信息复用、以及硬件上的真实延迟。对于训练侧，草稿模型蒸馏如何利用目标 VLM 的跨模态中间表示，也可作为多模态模型压缩和协同推理的参考。
summary.technical_approach: DREAM-S 把 VLM speculative decoding 中的草稿模型设计表述为一个 NAS 问题。搜索对象不只是草稿模型宽度或深度，还包括输入剪枝比例、草稿模型与目标模型的连接方式、以及不同硬件平台上的速度—接受率权衡。训练侧使用 two-phase progressive training：先 warm-up 训练完整草稿模型，再进入可搜索配置训练。另一个核心模块是 adaptive intermediate feature distillation。它从目标 VLM 的中间层动态选择更有信息量的隐藏状态，用注意力熵等信号指导选择，再通过交叉注意力把目标模型的中间表示注入草稿模型。这样做的目标是提高草稿 token 与目标模型输出的一致性，而不是单纯缩小草稿模型。与常规 speculative decoding 相比，DREAM-S 的主要差别在于：它把多模态输入剪枝、中间层蒸馏、草稿—目标交互策略和硬件约束放在同一个搜索框架里优化。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 LLaVA-v1.6-Vicuna-7B/13B、SmolVLM-2B、Pixtral-12B 等 VLM，并在多类视觉语言生成任务上比较常规解码和已有 speculative decoding 方法。给出的主要结果是最高可达到 3.85× 加速，同时保持较高接受率。消融重点应在三个部分：NAS 搜索出的草稿配置是否优于手工配置；中间层特征蒸馏是否提升 token 接受长度；输入剪枝和交互策略在不同目标模型、不同硬件上的选择是否稳定。给定内容未提供完整表格数字，因此不能进一步确认平均加速、质量退化幅度和各消融项的独立贡献。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 20–30 分钟。优先看 Methodology 中 Figure 2，对齐训练和推理流程；再看 TPPT、AIFD、cross-attention feature reuse 的具体实现；实验部分重点看速度提升表、接受率、质量指标和消融。无需细读任务背景和 VLM 应用介绍。若只关心 LLM pretrain，可把它作为“多模态 speculative decoding 中草稿模型如何训练”的案例，而不是预训练方法论文。

summary_en.core_problem: DREAM-S targets speculative decoding for autoregressive VLM generation. Draft-model acceleration methods designed for text-only LLMs do not transfer cleanly to VLMs, because visual tokens, text tokens, cross-modal interactions, and target-model intermediate states all affect both acceptance rate and latency.
summary_en.importance: The work is mainly an inference-efficiency paper rather than a pretraining paper. Its useful lesson for foundation-model researchers is that VLM decoding acceleration needs more than a small language draft model. Visual input pruning, reuse of target-model intermediate representations, and hardware-aware latency all matter. The distillation design is also relevant to multimodal compression: the draft model is trained to exploit cross-modal hidden states from the target model, not just to imitate final logits.
summary_en.technical_approach: DREAM-S formulates VLM speculative decoding as a neural architecture search problem. The search space includes draft-model configuration, input pruning ratio, and interaction strategy between draft and target models, with the objective tied to the target hardware. Training uses a two-phase progressive procedure: first training the full draft model, then training searchable configurations. The second key component is adaptive intermediate feature distillation. Target-model middle-layer features are selected dynamically, guided by signals such as attention entropy, and injected into the draft model through cross-attention. This is intended to improve draft-token agreement with the target model and extend accepted token runs. Compared with standard speculative decoding, the main difference is that DREAM-S jointly optimizes multimodal input pruning, intermediate-feature supervision, draft-target coupling, and hardware-aware speed.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers LLaVA-v1.6-Vicuna-7B/13B, SmolVLM-2B, and Pixtral-12B on multiple vision-language generation tasks. The reported headline result is up to 3.85× speedup over conventional decoding while maintaining high acceptance rates. The important ablations are the NAS-selected draft configuration versus manual choices, the contribution of adaptive intermediate feature distillation, and the stability of pruning and interaction choices across target VLMs and hardware settings. The provided content does not include the full experimental tables, so average speedup, quality degradation, and per-component gains cannot be verified here.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Start with Figure 2 and the Methodology section to understand the training and inference pipeline. Then read the details of TPPT, AIFD, and cross-attention-based feature reuse. In the experiments, focus on latency, acceptance rate, quality preservation, and ablations. The application background can be skipped. For LLM pretraining researchers, this is best read as a case study in training multimodal draft models for speculative decoding.

recommendation.zh: 多模态推测解码的工程化落地方案，注意力熵引导蒸馏的设计可参考，重点看§3的NAS搜索空间和实验结果
recommendation.en: Engineering implementation of multimodal speculative decoding; the attention-entropy guided distillation design is worth referencing, focus on §3 search space and experimental results

summary_en.core_problem: Existing AI music systems only support short isolated clip generation, cannot ensure soundtrack coherence across long video scene transitions
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation, proposes a modular interpretable long-form video soundtracking framework with adaptive transition mechanism
summary_en.technical_approach: Trains Transformer generative model with flow matching objective, adopts two-stage paradigm: pretrain on large text-audio corpus to get musical priors, then adapt to video domain with dual text-visual conditioning, plus adaptive transition mechanism

recommendation.en: The flow matching approach for long audio coherence can be referenced as incremental multimodal generation work, no need to read full text

paper.title: Geometric Erasure by Contrastive Velocity Matching in Rectified Flows
paper.abstract: While the rapid adoption of multimodal generative models offers immense potential, it has also increased the risks of harmful content synthesis, deepfakes, and copyright infringements. To address these challenges, concept erasure has emerged as a prospective safeguard. However, as the field gradually transitions from U-Net-based diffusion models to Rectified Flow Transformers, erasure research has struggled to keep pace. In this work, we introduce GEM, a simple but highly effective erasure frame

summary.core_problem: 面向 Rectified Flow Transformer 生成模型，解决概念擦除方法从 U-Net diffusion 迁移到 flow 模型后缺少稳定训练目标的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态生成安全与模型编辑方法改进。它关注的不是文本 LM 预训练，而是新一代 flow-based 图像生成模型中的 unlearning / concept erasure，这对理解 flow 目标下的负向训练信号有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 GEM，将基于轨迹的 unlearning 信号转写为 teacher-guided flow matching。教师模型同时提供 attraction 与 repulsion 两类信号，再合成为一个几何引导目标，用于压制目标概念并尽量保留非目标生成能力。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、数据集、baseline 和数值结果。实验重点应是 Rectified Flow 模型上的目标概念抑制、非目标概念保持，以及相对传统 teacher-guided erasure 或 trajectory-based 方法的效果对比。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses concept erasure for Rectified Flow Transformer generative models, where methods designed for U-Net diffusion models do not directly transfer cleanly.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a method-level advance in safety and model editing for multimodal generation. It is not LLM pretraining, but it is relevant for researchers tracking flow objectives and negative training signals in modern generative models.
summary_en.technical_approach: GEM translates trajectory-based unlearning signals into a teacher-guided flow-matching setup. A teacher supplies complementary attraction and repulsion signals, which are combined into a geometric guidance objective for targeted concept suppression.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model scale, datasets, baselines, or numerical gains. The relevant evaluation should compare target erasure, preservation of non-target concepts, and robustness against prior teacher-guided or trajectory-based erasure methods on Rectified Flow models.

recommendation.zh: 看方法目标即可；它对文本预训练不直接有用，但负向 flow matching 的构造可作安全训练信号备查。
recommendation.en: Read the objective only; it is not directly useful for text pretraining, but the negative flow-matching signal is worth filing for safety training.

Existing paradigms address only fragments of this challenge: single-shot extrapolation preserves an anchor but lacks cinematic structure, while multi-shot storytelling imposes structure yet remains free to invent its visual states rather than continue an observed one. summary.core_problem: 现有长视频生成范式无法同时兼顾锚定初始视觉状态、保持电影化叙事结构和长期对象/场景状态一致性，缺乏统一的多镜头视频外推任务定义
summary.importance: 首次正式定义多镜头视频外推（MSVE）任务，属于多模态生成领域的任务与方法创新
summary.technical_approach: 提出ReCA递归上下文分配框架，针对性解决三个瓶颈：避免全局规划器过度指定不支持的细节、精简镜头级prompt保留关键状态、缓解时序链式生成中的状态衰减
summary.experiments: 在分钟级电影级视频基准上测试，对比单镜头外推和多镜头叙事基线，在状态保持和叙事连贯性上取得提升，未披露具体生成模型参数量
summary.authors_note: 作者包含莫纳什大学Gholamreza Haffari团队成员，无头部大模型机构背景

summary_en.importance: First formal definition of Multi-Shot Video Extrapolation (MSVE) task, task and method innovation in multimodal generation field
summary_en.technical_approach: Propose ReCA recursive context allocation framework, addressing three bottlenecks: avoiding over-specification by global planners, simplify shot-level prompts to retain key state, mitigating state decay in temporal chaining

summary_en.authors_note: Authors include members from Gholamreza Haffari's group at Monash University, no top-tier LLM institution affiliation

paper.title: Visual-Redundancy-Controlled Parallel Decoding for Diffusion-Based Multimodal Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Diffusion-based multimodal large language models (dMLLMs) decode by iteratively predicting tokens at multiple masked positions in parallel. This turns each decoding step into a position-selection problem: the model must choose not only which predictions are reliable in isolation, but also which positions should be committed together as context for later decoding steps. summary.core_problem: 现有扩散多模态大模型的并行解码策略独立选择高置信度token，忽略视觉grounding重叠引入的冗余，降低后续解码的互补视觉信息利用率
summary.importance: 方法创新，首次提出量化并行解码视觉冗余的指标，设计对应的冗余控制解码策略，提升扩散多模态模型生成质量

summary.experiments: 在扩散多模态大模型上验证，相比基线置信度解码方法，生成准确性和视觉grounding一致性有明确提升，摘要未披露具体模型参数量和提升幅度

summary_en.core_problem: Existing parallel decoding strategies for diffusion-based multimodal large language models select high-confidence tokens independently, ignoring redundancy caused by overlapping visual grounding, which reduces utilization of complementary visual information in subsequent decoding steps
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation, first proposes a metric to quantify visual redundancy in parallel decoding, and designs a corresponding redundancy-controlled decoding strategy to improve generation quality of diffusion multimodal models
summary_en.technical_approach: Propose Visual Redundancy Index (VRI) to quantify visual grounding overlap of tokens committed in the same decoding step, design a visual-redundancy-controlled parallel decoding algorithm that prioritizes committing token sets with complementary visual information as context
summary_en.experiments: Verified on diffusion-based multimodal large language models, showing clear improvements in generation accuracy and visual grounding consistency compared to baseline confidence-based decoding methods; specific model size and performance lift are not disclosed in the abstract

recommendation.zh: 扩散多模态解码的增量优化工作，仅对做多模态扩散生成的研究员有参考，看方法部分即可
recommendation.en: Incremental optimization for diffusion MLLM decoding, only relevant for researchers working on multimodal diffusion generation, refer to the method section only.

paper.title: PaintCopilot: Modeling Painting as Autonomous Artistic Continuation
paper.abstract: We present PaintCopilot, a co-creative neural painting assistant that models painting as an open-ended autoregressive artistic behavior conditioned on evolving canvas states and prior brushstroke history, without requiring a target image. Unlike existing neural painting methods that frame painting as pixel reconstruction toward a predefined reference, PaintCopilot predicts future strokes directly from learned artistic dynamics, analogous to how large language models continue text sequences from

summary.core_problem: 现有神经绘画方法依赖预定义参考图做像素重建，无法支持开放协同创作
summary.importance: 首次将绘画建模为类LLM的自回归行为续写，提出无参考图的协同绘画助手框架
summary.technical_approach: 三个互补模型：ViT意图预测器，flow matching自回归笔触预测器，VAE区域采样器，支持四种交互工作流
summary.experiments: 未公开具体量化对比结果
summary.authors_note: MIT Media Lab，Paul Pu Liang团队专注多模态建模与统一表示研究

summary_en.core_problem: Existing neural painting methods rely on predefined reference images for pixel reconstruction, cannot support open-ended co-creation
summary_en.importance: First to model painting as LLM-like autoregressive behavior continuation, proposes a reference-free co-creative painting assistant framework
summary_en.technical_approach: Three complementary models: ViT intent predictor, flow matching autoregressive stroke predictor, VAE region sampler, supports four interactive workflows
summary_en.experiments: No specific quantitative comparison results are disclosed
summary_en.authors_note: MIT Media Lab, Paul Pu Liang's team focuses on multimodal modeling and unified representation research

recommendation.zh: 将AR文本建模范式迁移到笔触生成，做多模态统一生成研究时可参考建模思路
recommendation.en: Migrates AR text modeling paradigm to stroke generation, refer to modeling ideas when studying unified multimodal generation

paper.title: MSAVBench: Towards Comprehensive and Reliable Evaluation of Multi-Shot Audio-Video Generation
paper.abstract: Video generation is rapidly evolving from single-shot synthesis to complex multi-shot audio-video (MSAV) narratives to meet real-world demands. However, evaluating such frontier models remains a fundamental challenge. Existing benchmarks are limited in scope and data diversity, and rely on rigid evaluation pipelines, preventing systematic and reliable assessment of modern MSAV models. To bridge these gaps, we introduce MSAVBench, the first comprehensive benchmark and adaptive hybrid evaluation f

summary.core_problem: 现有多镜头音视频生成（MSAV）的评估基准覆盖维度窄、数据多样性不足、评估流程僵化，无法可靠评测新一代生成模型的实际效果。
summary.importance: 首个专门面向多镜头音视频生成的综合基准，属于benchmark贡献，填补了该领域统一评测的空白。
summary.technical_approach: 构建覆盖视频、音频、镜头、参考四大维度的基准数据集，最多包含15个镜头，覆盖非现实场景；设计自适应混合评估框架，通过镜头分割自校正、实例级主观指标规则、工具支撑的证据提取三个模块提升评估鲁棒性。
summary.experiments: 未公开评测的具体模型参数量，验证了评估框架输出与人类判断的高对齐度，可覆盖多种复杂任务场景的评测需求。
summary.authors_note: 阿里通义实验室联合复旦大学、香港大学、浙江大学、北京大学等机构发布。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing multi-shot audio-video (MSAV) generation evaluation benchmarks have limited coverage, low data diversity and rigid evaluation pipelines, which cannot reliably measure the performance of latest generation models.
summary_en.importance: The first comprehensive benchmark for multi-shot audio-video generation, fills the gap of unified evaluation in this field as a benchmark contribution.
summary_en.technical_approach: Builds a benchmark dataset covering 4 core dimensions of video, audio, shot and reference, with up to 15 shots and non-realistic scenarios; designs an adaptive hybrid evaluation framework with 3 modules: shot segmentation self-correction, instance-level subjective metric rubrics, tool-grounded evidence extraction to improve robustness.
summary_en.experiments: Specific model parameters for evaluation are not disclosed, the framework achieves high alignment with human judgment and supports evaluation of multiple complex task scenarios.
summary_en.authors_note: Released by Tongyi Lab (Alibaba Group) in collaboration with Fudan University, The University of Hong Kong, Zhejiang University, Peking University and other institutions.

recommendation.zh: 多镜头音视频生成评测新基准，仅做音视频生成预训练的团队可参考其评估维度，其余场景无参考价值。
recommendation.en: New benchmark for multi-shot audio-video generation evaluation, only refer to its evaluation dimensions if you work on audio-video generation pretraining, no value for other scenarios.

paper.title: MiVE: Multiscale Vision-language features for reference-guided video Editing
paper.abstract: Reference-guided video editing takes a source video, a text instruction, and a reference image as inputs, requiring the model to faithfully apply the instructed edits while preserving original motion and unedited content. Existing methods fall into two paradigms, each with inherent limitations: decoupled encoders suffer from modality gaps when processing instructions and visual content independently, while unified vision-language encoders lose fine-grained spatial details by relying solely on fi

summary.core_problem: 在参考图像引导的视频编辑中，同时保持文本指令语义、参考外观细节、原视频运动和未编辑区域一致性。
summary.importance: 贡献是多模态生成/视频编辑方法改进。论文利用 VLM 不同层的层级表征差异，缓解解耦编码器的模态间隙，以及只用统一 VLM 最后一层时丢失空间细节的问题。对预训练研究的价值主要是观察 VLM 层级表征如何服务生成控制。
summary.technical_approach: MiVE 将 Qwen3-VL 复用为多尺度视觉-语言特征提取器，从早层抽取局部空间细节，从深层抽取全局语义和指令理解信息，并把这些层级特征接入视频编辑模型。方法是对既有 VLM 表征的迁移使用，不是重新训练统一生成基座。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出视频编辑模型规模、训练数据、baseline 列表或定量提升。实验目标是验证多尺度 VLM 特征比解耦编码器和仅使用最终层 VLM 表征更适合参考引导视频编辑。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses reference-guided video editing, where the model must follow a text instruction and reference image while preserving the source video’s motion and unedited content.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a multimodal generation and video-editing method. It uses the hierarchical representations of VLMs to mitigate modality gaps in decoupled encoders and the loss of spatial detail when only final-layer unified VLM features are used. For pretraining researchers, the useful signal is how VLM layer structure transfers to generative control.
summary_en.technical_approach: MiVE repurposes Qwen3-VL as a multiscale vision-language feature extractor. Early layers provide local spatial detail, while deeper layers provide global semantics and instruction understanding; these hierarchical features are injected into the video-editing framework. This is a transfer of pretrained VLM representations rather than a new unified generative pretraining scheme.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model size, training data, baseline list, or quantitative gains. The experiments are positioned to test whether multiscale VLM features outperform decoupled encoders and final-layer-only VLM features for reference-guided video editing.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法图和层级特征消融；它不是预训练论文，但能提示 VLM 中间层别急着丢。
recommendation.en: Read only the method diagram and layer ablations; it is not a pretraining paper, but it cautions against discarding VLM intermediate layers.

paper.title: Edit-Compass & EditReward-Compass: A Unified Benchmark for Image Editing and Reward Modeling
paper.abstract: Recent image editing models have achieved remarkable progress in instruction following, multimodal understanding, and complex visual editing. However, existing benchmarks often fail to faithfully reflect human judgment, especially for strong frontier models, due to limited task difficulty and coarse-grained evaluation protocols. In parallel, reward models have become increasingly important for RL-based image editing optimization, yet existing reward model benchmarks still rely on unrealistic eva

summary.core_problem: 现有图像编辑benchmark任务难度低、评估协议粗，无法准确反映前沿模型的真实能力；奖励模型benchmark的评测设置不符合实际RL场景，限制了两类模型的可靠评估
summary.importance: 提出首个统一覆盖图像编辑和对应奖励建模的benchmark套件，属于benchmark贡献，填补了现有评估体系的缺口
summary.technical_approach: 构建Edit-Compass，包含2388个标注实例，覆盖6类难度递进的任务（含世界知识推理、视觉推理、多图像编辑等）；配套EditReward-Compass，设计贴近实际RL训练的奖励模型评测协议
summary.experiments: 评测了多个主流图像编辑模型和奖励模型，验证了现有模型在复杂编辑任务上的能力短板，以及现有奖励模型在真实RL场景下的泛化性不足

summary_en.core_problem: Existing image editing benchmarks have low task difficulty and coarse evaluation protocols, failing to reflect frontier model capabilities; reward model benchmarks use settings deviating from real RL scenarios, hindering reliable assessment of both types of models
summary_en.importance: Proposes the first unified benchmark suite covering both image editing and corresponding reward modeling, a benchmark contribution filling gaps in existing evaluation systems
summary_en.technical_approach: Builds Edit-Compass with 2,388 annotated instances covering 6 progressively difficult task categories including world knowledge reasoning, visual reasoning, multi-image editing; develops EditReward-Compass with reward model evaluation protocols close to real RL training
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated multiple mainstream image editing and reward models, verified capability shortcomings of existing models on complex editing tasks, and insufficient generalization of existing reward models in real RL scenarios

recommendation.zh: 图像编辑奖励建模的benchmark设计可参考，做多模态生成对齐时可复用评测思路，无需读全文
recommendation.en: The benchmark design for image editing reward modeling is referenceable for multimodal generation alignment, no need to read full text

paper.title: Images in Sentences: Scaling Interleaved Instructions for Unified Visual Generation
paper.abstract: While recent advancements in multimodal language models have enabled image generation from expressive multi-image instructions, existing methods struggle to maintain performance under complex interleaved instructions. This limitation stems from the structural separation of images and text in current paradigms, which forces models to bridge difficult long-range dependencies to match descriptions with visual targets. To address these challenges, we propose \texttt{I}mages i\texttt{N} \texttt{SE}n\

summary.core_problem: 现有的多模态生成模型在处理复杂的交错图文指令（interleaved instructions）时，由于采用间接的基于查询的范式（如“图1中的狗”），导致模型难以在长距离依赖中准确绑定文本描述与视觉目标，且缺乏高质量的复杂交错训练数据。
summary.importance: 提出了一种将图像作为原生词汇嵌入文本指令的新范式，从根本上解决了多图像生成中的长距离依赖和属性绑定问题。同时构建了大规模高质量的交错数据集，为统一视觉生成模型的预训练提供了重要的数据基础和方法论参考。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Inset 模型，将视觉特征直接放置在指令中对应的语义槽位（例如“一个 [Image1] 机器人拿着一个 [Image2] 花瓶”），利用 Transformer 的上下文局部性实现精确的对象绑定。为了支持这种训练，开发了一个可扩展的数据引擎，利用 VLM 和 LLM 从静态图像和视频数据集中构建了 1500 万个高质量的交错样本。对于视频，利用 VLM 建立帧间的对象对应关系，提取动态对象进行交错数据合成。
summary.experiments: 在基于 BAGEL 架构的实现上，使用 15M 样本进行训练。在作者提出的 InterleaveBench 基准测试中，Inset 在多图像一致性方面超越了所有竞争方法，并在文本对齐方面显著优于开源模型。随着输入图像数量的增加，其性能优势愈发明显，验证了该方法的可扩展性。此外，该交错格式自然泛化到了多模态图像编辑任务。
summary.reading_guide: 强烈建议精读 Method 部分（Sec 3.1），理解“Native Interleaved Formulation”与传统 query-based 方法的本质区别。Sec 3.2 的数据引擎设计（特别是视频数据的处理）非常有启发性，展示了如何合成高质量的 pretrain 数据。实验部分关注 InterleaveBench 上的多图像一致性指标。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing multimodal generation models struggle with complex interleaved image-text instructions because their indirect query-based paradigm (e.g., 'the dog in Image 1') makes it difficult to accurately bind text descriptions to visual targets over long-range dependencies. Furthermore, there is a lack of high-quality complex interleaved training data.
summary_en.importance: Introduces a novel paradigm that embeds images as native vocabulary within text instructions, fundamentally solving the long-range dependency and attribute binding issues in multi-image generation. It also provides a large-scale, high-quality interleaved dataset, offering crucial data foundation and methodological insights for pretraining unified visual generation models.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Inset, which places visual features directly at their corresponding semantic slots within the instruction (e.g., 'A [Image1] robot holds a [Image2] flower vase'), leveraging the contextual locality of Transformers for precise object binding. To support this, a scalable data engine is developed using VLMs and LLMs to construct 15M high-quality interleaved samples from static image and video datasets. For videos, VLMs establish object correspondence across frames to extract dynamic objects for interleaved data synthesis.
summary_en.experiments: Implemented on top of the BAGEL architecture and trained on 15M samples. On the proposed InterleaveBench, Inset surpasses all competing methods in multi-image consistency and significantly outperforms open-source models in text alignment. The performance advantage becomes more pronounced as the number of input images increases, validating scalability. The interleaved format also naturally generalizes to multimodal image editing.
summary_en.reading_guide: Highly recommend closely reading the Method section (Sec 3.1) to understand the fundamental difference between the 'Native Interleaved Formulation' and traditional query-based methods. The data engine design in Sec 3.2 (especially video processing) is highly inspiring for synthesizing high-quality pretrain data. In the experiments, focus on the multi-image consistency metrics on InterleaveBench.

recommendation.zh: 将图像作为原生token嵌入文本序列的统一建模范式值得参考，可复用其数据引擎设计做内部多模态预训练消融
recommendation.en: This unified modeling paradigm of treating images as native text tokens is worth referencing; replicate its data engine design for internal multimodal pretrain ablations.

paper.title: Beyond Text Prompts: Visual-to-Visual Generation as A Unified Paradigm
paper.abstract: Humans often specify and create through visual artifacts: typography sheets, sketches, reference images, and annotated scenes. Yet modern visual generators still ask users to serialize this intent into text, a bottleneck that compresses signals like spatial structure, exact appearance, and glyph shape. We propose \textbf{\emph{visual-to-visual} (V2V)} generation, in which the user conditions a generative model with a visual specification page rather than a text prompt. The page is not an edit ta

summary.core_problem: 现有视觉生成模型依赖文本prompt序列化用户意图，会压缩空间结构、精确外观、字形等细粒度信号，成为生成质量瓶颈
summary.importance: 提出视觉到视觉（V2V）生成的统一范式，属于多模态生成交互范式探索，首次提出无需微调现有VLM条件生成器的V2V适配方案
summary.technical_approach: 提出训练免费的V2V-Zero框架，利用冻结VLM已将文本和图像映射到同一条件空间的特性，用视觉规范页的最后一层隐藏态替代文本条件，直接接入现有生成器
summary.experiments: 在GenEval基准上，基于冻结的Qwen-Image backbone达到0.85分，性能接近有监督微调方法
summary.authors_note: 作者来自香港城市大学、香港科技大学、香港中文大学等机构，无LLM领域知名研究者

summary_en.core_problem: Modern visual generators rely on text prompts to serialize user intent, which compresses fine-grained signals such as spatial structure, exact appearance and glyph shape, becoming a generation quality bottleneck
summary_en.importance: Proposes the unified visual-to-visual (V2V) generation paradigm, a multimodal generation interaction paradigm exploration, and introduces the first training-free V2V adaptation scheme for existing VLM-conditioned generators
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes the training-free V2V-Zero framework, which leverages the property that frozen VLMs already map both text and images to the same conditioning space, replacing text conditioning with final-layer hidden states extracted from visual specification pages
summary_en.experiments: On the GenEval benchmark, the framework achieves a score of 0.85 with a frozen Qwen-Image backbone, performance close to supervised fine-tuning methods
summary_en.authors_note: Authors are from City University of Hong Kong, Hong Kong University of Science and Technology, Chinese University of Hong Kong, etc. No well-known LLM researchers are identified

recommendation.zh: 多模态生成交互范式的小探索，仅做多模态生成的研究员可扫一眼摘要，无LLM预训练相关核心insight
recommendation.en: A minor exploration of multimodal generation interaction paradigm, only researchers focusing on multimodal generation may glance at the abstract, no core insight for LLM pretraining
