summary.core_problem: 在不从头联合训练 AR 与 diffusion 大模型的前提下，把预训练 VLM 的语义理解能力高效迁移到图像生成与编辑。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态生成方法改进：通过表示对齐的 latent embedding，把 VLM 的理解能力作为条件信号接入扩散模型，试图用更低训练成本获得更强的多图理解、空间推理和编辑能力。
summary.technical_approach: MMCORE 使用预训练 VLM，通过可学习 query tokens 预测语义视觉 embedding，再将这些 representation-aligned latent 作为 diffusion model 的条件输入。核心思路不是深度融合 AR 与 diffusion，也不是从头训练统一模型，而是做一个轻量桥接层，把理解模型的 latent 空间接到生成模型上。
summary.experiments: 摘要声称在 text-to-image、单图/多图编辑、交错图像生成等任务上超过现有方法，并在空间推理和 visual grounding 场景表现更稳。未给出参数量、训练数据规模、baseline 名称和具体提升幅度，因此目前更适合作为方法思路参考，而不是结论直接采信。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper aims to transfer the semantic understanding of a pretrained VLM into image generation and editing without expensive joint training of AR and diffusion models from scratch.
summary_en.importance: This is a multimodal-generation method paper. Its contribution is a representation-aligned latent interface that uses VLM semantics as conditioning for diffusion, targeting stronger multi-image understanding, spatial reasoning, and editing at lower training cost.
summary_en.technical_approach: MMCORE uses a pretrained VLM to predict semantic visual embeddings through learnable query tokens, then feeds these aligned latent representations into a diffusion model as conditioning signals. The key design choice is a lightweight bridge rather than deep AR-diffusion fusion or full end-to-end retraining.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims gains over prior methods on text-to-image, single-/multi-image editing, and interleaved image generation, especially in spatial reasoning and visual grounding scenarios. However, it gives no model sizes, data scale, baseline names, or exact margins, so this is more useful as a design pattern than as a fully trusted empirical result.

recommendation.zh: 这是个典型“别从头训统一模型，先做 latent 接口”的工程思路；看 query-token 到 diffusion conditioning 这条桥怎么搭，结论先保守。
recommendation.en: This is a classic 'don’t retrain a unified model from scratch—build a latent interface first' paper; inspect the query-token-to-diffusion bridge, but treat the headline results cautiously.

paper.title: Exploring Spatial Intelligence from a Generative Perspective
paper.abstract: Spatial intelligence is essential for multimodal large language models, yet current benchmarks largely assess it only from an understanding perspective. We ask whether modern generative or unified multimodal models also possess generative spatial intelligence (GSI), the ability to respect and manipulate 3D spatial constraints during image generation, and whether such capability can be measured or improved. We introduce GSI-Bench, the first benchmark designed to quantify GSI through spatially gro

summary.core_problem: 解决现有空间智能评测主要停留在理解侧，缺少对生成模型是否真正遵守 3D 空间约束的系统测量问题。
summary.importance: 主要贡献是 benchmark：把“生成式空间智能”定义出来，并给出真实+合成双数据源的评测协议。对统一多模态模型有一定启发，但更偏图像编辑/生成评测，而不是 LLM 预训练方法本身。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 GSI-Bench，用空间约束驱动的图像编辑任务评估模型的 generative spatial intelligence。数据由两部分组成：GSI-Real 通过 3D 先验引导的生成与过滤流程构建，GSI-Syn 通过可控空间操作自动生成并自动标注。论文还报告用 GSI-Syn 微调统一多模态模型可提升空间遵循能力。
summary.experiments: 摘要显示 benchmark 同时覆盖真实场景与可控合成场景，并提供统一评测协议；实验发现现代生成式或统一多模态模型在空间约束遵循上仍有明显缺口，而在 GSI-Syn 上微调后可改善。未见模型规模、训练 token 或关键 baseline 细节，当前更像评测资源论文。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自浙江大学、西湖大学等。工作重心是空间智能 benchmark 与生成式评测，不是基座预训练目标或 tokenizer 研究。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the lack of systematic evaluation for whether generative or unified multimodal models can actually obey 3D spatial constraints, beyond standard understanding-oriented spatial benchmarks.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is a benchmark: it defines generative spatial intelligence and provides a real-plus-synthetic evaluation protocol. This is somewhat relevant to unified multimodal models, but it is primarily an image editing/generation evaluation paper rather than an LLM pretraining paper.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces GSI-Bench, which evaluates generative spatial intelligence through spatially grounded image editing. It contains GSI-Real, built with a 3D-prior-guided generation-and-filtering pipeline, and GSI-Syn, a synthetic benchmark with controllable spatial operations and automatic labels. The paper also studies fine-tuning unified multimodal models on GSI-Syn.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark covers both real and controllable synthetic settings under a unified protocol. The abstract suggests that current generative or unified multimodal models still struggle with spatial compliance, and that fine-tuning on GSI-Syn improves this ability. No model sizes, training scales, or detailed baselines are given in the abstract, so this currently reads as a benchmark paper.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Zhejiang University, Westlake University, and related institutions. The focus is spatial-intelligence benchmarking and generative evaluation, not foundation-model pretraining objectives or tokenization.

recommendation.zh: 更像评测资源而非方法论文；如果你做 native multimodal generation，只需看 benchmark 定义和失败案例，别指望它回答预训练怎么改。
recommendation.en: This is more of an evaluation resource than a methods paper; if you work on native multimodal generation, read the benchmark definition and failure cases, but do not expect pretraining guidance.

institutions: State Key Laboratory of CAD & CG
Zhejiang University, State Key Laboratory of CAD & CG

paper.title: Seedance 2.0: Advancing Video Generation for World Complexity

summary.core_problem: 如何用统一架构实现原生音视频联合生成，并支持多模态输入参考与编辑，在世界复杂度更高的场景下提升生成质量与可控性。
summary.importance: 更偏“产品/技术报告式”的多模态生成模型发布；对基座研究的价值在于统一多模态生成架构与能力面板，但摘要缺少训练细节与可复现信息，研究启发受限。
summary.technical_approach: 提出统一且高效的大规模架构进行音视频联合生成，支持文本/图像/音频/视频四种输入，并提供丰富的参考与编辑能力；具体建模范式（扩散/自回归/flow等）、tokenization与训练目标未在摘要中说明。
summary.experiments: 给出可生成4-15秒、480p/720p原生分辨率音视频；声称在专家评测与用户测试中达到领先水平，但未提供公开基准、对比对象与量化指标。

summary_en.core_problem: How to build a unified architecture for native joint audio-video generation with multimodal conditioning and editing, improving quality and controllability under higher world complexity.
summary_en.importance: More like a product/technical-report style release for a multimodal generative model. Potential value lies in unified audio-video generation and capability coverage, but the abstract lacks training and reproducibility details, limiting research takeaways.
summary_en.technical_approach: A unified, efficient large-scale architecture for joint audio-video generation supporting text/image/audio/video inputs and rich reference/editing features; the underlying modeling paradigm (diffusion vs AR vs flow), tokenization, and objectives are not specified in the abstract.
summary_en.experiments: Supports 4–15s audio-video generation at native 480p/720p. Claims near-leading performance in expert and public tests, but provides no standardized benchmarks, baselines, or quantitative metrics.

recommendation.zh: 改变的prior是“音视频可在统一自回归框架里端到端生成并可编辑”，值得立刻对照自家路线图做架构对齐；但细节像产品发布，训练配方不透明需谨慎采信。
recommendation.en: It updates the prior that joint audio-video generation+editing can live in one unified autoregressive stack—worth mapping against your internal roadmap immediately; but it reads like a product drop, so treat training claims cautiously.

paper.title: VidAudio-Bench: Benchmarking V2A and VT2A Generation across Four Audio Categories

summary.core_problem: 视频到音频（V2A）/视频-文本到音频（VT2A）生成缺少细粒度、可对齐人类偏好的系统评测，且不同音频类别（音效/音乐/语音/歌唱）需求差异大。
summary.importance: Benchmark贡献：提出面向V2A/VT2A的多任务评测集与指标体系，并通过主观实验验证指标与人类偏好一致性；有助于推动多模态生成模型的可比评测与迭代。
summary.technical_approach: 构建VidAudio-Bench：覆盖四类音频与两种设定（V2A、VT2A）；提出13个任务特定、reference-free指标，分别评估音质、视频-音频一致性、文本-音频一致性；用人类主观研究验证指标有效性，并对11个SOTA生成模型进行基准测试。
summary.experiments: 数据规模1,634个video-text pair；评测11个生成模型；提供13个无参考指标并做主观对齐验证（摘要未给出各模型具体排名/提升幅度与显著性细节）。

summary_en.core_problem: Video-to-audio (V2A) and video+text-to-audio (VT2A) generation lack standardized, fine-grained evaluation that aligns with human preferences, especially across distinct audio categories with different requirements (sound effects, music, speech, singing).
summary_en.importance: Provides a comprehensive benchmark and metric suite for V2A/VT2A, with human-subject validation of metric–preference alignment, enabling more comparable and actionable evaluation of multimodal audio generation systems.
summary_en.technical_approach: VidAudio-Bench covers four audio categories under both V2A and VT2A settings, and proposes 13 task-specific reference-free metrics spanning audio quality, video–audio consistency, and text–audio consistency; the benchmark includes a human study to validate the metrics and a standardized protocol to evaluate multiple state-of-the-art models.
summary_en.experiments: Built from 1,634 video–text pairs; benchmarks 11 contemporary generation models and validates the proposed 13 no-reference metrics via subjective studies, though the abstract omits detailed rankings and statistical results.

recommendation.zh: 当作评测工具箱看：只读指标与主观一致性那几页，能快速判断你自家V2A改动是否真提升而非“听感玄学”。
recommendation.en: Treat it as an evaluation toolkit: skim the metrics and human-alignment validation to sanity-check whether your V2A changes improve quality beyond vibes.

paper.title: GeRM: A Generative Rendering Model From Physically Realistic to Photorealistic

summary.core_problem: 弥合物理真实的PBR与视觉“照片真实感”(PRR)之间的差距，在可控性/几何一致性与生成逼真度之间取得统一。
summary.importance: 方法创新+问题定义：提出PBR到PRR的P2P gap并尝试用“生成式渲染模型”统一显式物理渲染与隐式生成模型；对可控多模态生成/可微渲染+生成融合有启发。
summary.technical_approach: 提出多模态生成式渲染模型GeRM：将物理属性（如G-buffers等中间渲染缓冲/几何与材质相关表征）与文本提示联合建模，并采用渐进式/增量式生成流程以保持几何一致性与可控编辑（摘要信息不完整，细节待看正文）。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、训练数据规模、对比基线与定量结果；仅宣称为“first multi-modal generative rendering model”并展示从PBR到PRR的统一能力。

institutions: State Key Lab of CAD&CG, Zhejiang University and Zhejiang Lab
State Key Laboratory of Industrial Control Technology, Zhejiang University

summary_en.core_problem: Bridging the gap between physically based rendering (PBR), which offers strong controllability and geometric consistency, and photorealistic rendering (PRR), which emphasizes perceptual realism but is often less controllable.
summary_en.importance: Introduces and formalizes the PBR-to-PRR “P2P gap” and proposes a unified generative rendering perspective that connects explicit physical rendering pipelines with implicit generative models, informing controllable multimodal generation and hybrid differentiable rendering approaches.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes GeRM, a multimodal generative rendering model that jointly conditions on physical/geometry-related render buffers (e.g., G-buffers and other intermediate representations) and text prompts, using a progressive/incremental generation procedure intended to preserve geometry while enabling controllable edits.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract mainly positions GeRM as an initial multimodal generative rendering model and demonstrates unified PBR-to-PRR capability; it does not report model/data scale, baselines, or quantitative results.

recommendation.zh: glance：问题提法新但更像渲染/视觉论文；只需看他们如何定义PBR→PRR gap与评测，作为“可控+逼真”融合的备查。
recommendation.en: Glance: more rendering/vision than pretrain; just check how they formalize the PBR→PRR gap and evaluation—useful as a reference point for controllability-vs-realism tradeoffs.

paper.title: AVGen-Bench: A Task-Driven Benchmark for Multi-Granular Evaluation of Text-to-Audio-Video Generation

summary.core_problem: 现有Text-to-Audio-Video(T2AV)生成评测割裂且粗粒度，难以衡量真实提示词下音视频联合语义正确性与可控性，亟需任务驱动、细粒度的统一评测基准。
summary.importance: Benchmark贡献：提出面向T2AV生成的任务驱动评测集与多粒度评测框架，揭示当前系统“美学强但语义可靠性弱”的系统性短板，为后续统一多模态生成模型的训练目标与对齐提供可量化抓手。
summary.technical_approach: 构建AVGen-Bench：覆盖11类真实世界场景的高质量prompt；提出多粒度评测框架：结合轻量专用评测模型（perceptual/局部属性）与MLLM评测（细粒度语义一致性、可控性、跨模态一致性），避免仅用embedding相似度的粗评估。
summary.experiments: 在多种T2AV生成模型上进行系统评测（摘要未给出具体模型/规模细节）；主要发现包括：文本渲染、语音连贯性、物理推理、音乐音高控制等方面存在普遍失败，显示语义可靠性显著落后于视听美学质量。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing text-to-audio-video (T2AV) evaluation is fragmented and overly coarse, making it hard to measure semantic correctness, controllability, and cross-modal consistency under realistic prompts.
summary_en.importance: Provides a task-driven benchmark and multi-granular evaluation protocol that reveals a systematic gap between strong audiovisual aesthetics and weak semantic reliability in current T2AV systems, offering actionable targets for future alignment and training objectives.
summary_en.technical_approach: Builds AVGen-Bench with high-quality prompts across 11 real-world scenario categories and proposes a multi-level evaluation framework combining lightweight specialist evaluators (perceptual/local attributes) with MLLM-based judging for fine-grained semantic alignment, controllability, and audio–video consistency beyond embedding-similarity metrics.
summary_en.experiments: Conducts a broad evaluation of multiple T2AV generators (specific models not detailed in the abstract) and identifies common failures such as text rendering, speech coherence, physical reasoning, and musical pitch control, indicating semantics lag behind perceived audiovisual quality.

recommendation.zh: glance：作为评测基准备查即可；重点看他们把语义正确性拆成哪些可测任务，能直接迁移到你自己的多模态对齐评估。
recommendation.en: Glance: keep it as a benchmark reference; look at how they decompose “semantic correctness” into actionable tasks—you can reuse that structure for your own multimodal alignment evals.
